multilingual denoising pre training for.subject: mBART

multilingual denoising pre training for.subject: mBART

multilingual denoising pre training for.subject: mBART

are transformers universal approximators.subject: Transformer models

are transformers universal approximators.quote: In this paper, we establish that Transformer models are universal approximators of continuous permutation equivariant sequence-to-sequence functions with compact support, which is quite surprising given the amount of shared parameters in these models.

are transformers universal approximators.subject: Transformer models

are transformers universal approximators.quote: Furthermore, using positional encodings, we circumvent the restriction of permutation equivariance, and show that Transformer models can universally approximate arbitrary continuous sequence-to-sequence functions on a compact domain.

pytorch an imperative style high perform.subject: PyTorch

exploiting reverse target side contexts.quote: and (2) our enhanced Transformer outperforms the standard Transformer by 1.56/-1.49, 1.76/-2.49, and 1.29/-1.33 average BLEU and TER points, respectively.

towards understanding neural machine tra.quote: Specifically, we measure the word importance by attributing the NMT output to every input word through a gradient-based method.

towards understanding neural machine tra.subject: gradient-based word importance attribution
towards understanding neural machine tra.claim: The approach demonstrates superiority in identifying input words with higher influence on translation performance when validated on perturbation operations, language pairs, and model architectures.
towards understanding neural machine tra.quote: We validate the approach on a couple of perturbation operations, language pairs, and model architectures, demonstrating its superiority on identifying input words with higher influence on translation performance.

towards understanding neural machine tra.subject: gradient-based word importance attribution
towards understanding neural machine tra.claim: The calculated importance can serve as indicators of input words that are under-translated by NMT models.
towards understanding neural machine tra.quote: Encouragingly, the calculated importance can serve as indicators of input words that are under-translated by NMT models.

towards understanding neural machine tra.subject: gradient-based word importance attribution
towards understanding neural machine tra.claim: Words of certain syntactic categories have higher importance, and these categories vary across language pairs.
towards understanding neural machine tra.quote: Furthermore, our analysis reveals that words of certain syntactic categories have higher importance while the categories vary across language pairs, which can inspire better design principles of NMT architectures for multi-lingual translation.

towards understanding neural machine tra.subject: neural machine translation
towards understanding neural machine tra.claim: The interpretability of NMT remains unsatisfactory.
towards understanding neural machine tra.quote: Although neural machine translation (NMT) has advanced the state-of-the-art on various language pairs, the interpretability of NMT remains unsatisfactory.

latent part of speech sequences for neur.subject: LaSyn
latent part of speech sequences for neur.claim: LaSyn is a new latent variable model that captures the co-dependence between syntax and semantics while allowing for effective and efficient inference over the latent space.
latent part of speech sequences for neur.quote: In this work, we introduce a new latent variable model, LaSyn, that captures the co-dependence between syntax and semantics, while allowing for effective and efficient inference over the latent space.

latent part of speech sequences for neur.subject: LaSyn
latent part of speech sequences for neur.claim: LaSyn decouples direct dependence between successive latent variables, which allows its decoder to exhaustively search through the latent syntactic choices while keeping decoding speed proportional to the size of the latent variable vocabulary.
latent part of speech sequences for neur.quote: LaSyn decouples direct dependence between successive latent variables, which allows its decoder to exhaustively search through the latent syntactic choices, while keeping decoding speed proportional to the size of the latent variable vocabulary.

latent part of speech sequences for neur.subject: LaSyn
latent part of speech sequences for neur.claim: LaSyn is implemented by modifying a transformer-based NMT system and uses a neural expectation maximization algorithm regularized with part-of-speech information as the latent sequences.
latent part of speech sequences for neur.quote: We implement LaSyn by modifying a transformer-based NMT system and design a neural expectation maximization algorithm that we regularize with part-of-speech information as the latent sequences.

latent part of speech sequences for neur.subject: LaSyn
latent part of speech sequences for neur.claim: Incorporating target side syntax with LaSyn improves both translation quality and provides an opportunity to improve diversity on four different MT tasks.
latent part of speech sequences for neur.quote: Evaluations on four different MT tasks show that incorporating target side syntax with LaSyn improves both translation quality, and also provides an opportunity to improve diversity.

latent part of speech sequences for neur.subject: greedy search
latent part of speech sequences for neur.claim: Models that incorporate syntax through latent variables often resort to greedy search, which only allows them to explore a limited portion of the latent space.
latent part of speech sequences for neur.quote: To avoid this, models often resort to greedy search which only allows them to explore a limited portion of the latent space.

improving back translation with uncertai.subject: uncertainty-based confidence estimation
improving back translation with uncertai.claim: The authors propose to quantify the confidence of NMT model predictions based on model uncertainty.
improving back translation with uncertai.quote: In this work, we propose to quantify the confidence of NMT model predictions based on model uncertainty.

improving back translation with uncertai.subject: word- and sentence-level confidence measures
improving back translation with uncertai.claim: The method utilizes word- and sentence-level confidence measures based on uncertainty to help back-translation cope with noise.
improving back translation with uncertai.quote: With word- and sentence-level confidence measures based on uncertainty, it is possible for back-translation to better cope with noise in synthetic bilingual corpora.

improving back translation with uncertai.subject: uncertainty-based confidence estimation
improving back translation with uncertai.claim: Experiments on Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks show that uncertainty-based confidence estimation significantly improves the performance of back-translation.
improving back translation with uncertai.quote: Experiments on Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks show that uncertainty-based confidence estimation significantly improves the performance of back-translation.

improving back translation with uncertai.subject: back-translation
improving back translation with uncertai.claim: Synthetic bilingual corpora generated by NMT models trained on limited authentic bilingual data are inevitably noisy.
improving back translation with uncertai.quote: While back-translation is simple and effective in exploiting abundant monolingual corpora to improve low-resource neural machine translation (NMT), the synthetic bilingual corpora generated by NMT models trained on limited authentic bilingual data are inevitably noisy.

on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.subject: Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.claim: One of the most common RL methods for MT does not optimize the expected reward.
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.quote: We prove that one of the most common RL methods for MT does not optimize the expected reward, as well as show that other methods take an infeasibly long time to converge.

on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.subject: Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.claim: Other RL methods for MT take an infeasibly long time to converge.
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.quote: We prove that one of the most common RL methods for MT does not optimize the expected reward, as well as show that other methods take an infeasibly long time to converge.

on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.subject: Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.claim: RL practices in MT are likely to improve performance only where the pre-trained parameters are already close to yielding the correct translation.
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.quote: In fact, our results suggest that RL practices in MT are likely to improve performance only where the pre-trained parameters are already close to yielding the correct translation.

on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.subject: Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.claim: Observed gains from RL in MT may be due to effects unrelated to the training signal, but rather from changes in the shape of the distribution curve.
on the weaknesses of reinforcement learn.quote: Our findings further suggest that observed gains may be due to effects unrelated to the training signal, but rather from changes in the shape of the distribution curve.

reducing word omission errors in neural.subject: contrastive learning approach
reducing word omission errors in neural.claim: The paper proposes a contrastive learning approach to reducing word omission errors in NMT by assigning higher probability to ground-truth translations and lower probability to automatically constructed erroneous translations.
reducing word omission errors in neural.quote: In this work, we propose a contrastive learning approach to reducing word omission errors in NMT. The basic idea is to enable the NMT model to assign a higher probability to a ground-truth translation and a lower probability to an erroneous translation, which is automatically constructed from the ground-truth translation by omitting words.

reducing word omission errors in neural.subject: negative example design
reducing word omission errors in neural.claim: The method designs different types of negative examples based on the number of omitted words, word frequency, and part of speech.
reducing word omission errors in neural.quote: We design different types of negative examples depending on the number of omitted words, word frequency, and part of speech.

reducing word omission errors in neural.subject: contrastive learning approach
reducing word omission errors in neural.claim: Experiments on Chinese-to-English, German-to-English, and Russian-to-English translation tasks show that the approach is effective in reducing word omission errors and achieves better translation performance than three baseline methods.
reducing word omission errors in neural.quote: Experiments on Chinese-to-English, German-to-English, and Russian-to-English translation tasks show that our approach is effective in reducing word omission errors and achieves better translation performance than three baseline methods.

beyond bleu training neural machine tran.subject: semantic similarity reward function
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.claim: The paper introduces an alternative reward function for optimizing NMT systems that is based on recent work in semantic similarity.
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.quote: In this paper, we introduce an alternative reward function for optimizing NMT systems that is based on recent work in semantic similarity.

beyond bleu training neural machine tran.subject: BLEU
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.claim: Training with BLEU has limitations including not assigning partial credit, having a limited range of output values, and penalizing semantically correct hypotheses that differ lexically from the reference.
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.quote: However, training with BLEU has some limitations: it doesn’t assign partial credit, it has a limited range of output values, and it can penalize semantically correct hypotheses if they differ lexically from the reference.

beyond bleu training neural machine tran.subject: semantic similarity reward function
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.claim: Training with the proposed metric results in better translations as evaluated by BLEU, semantic similarity, and human evaluation.
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.quote: We evaluate on four disparate languages trans-lated to English, and find that training with our proposed metric results in better translations as evaluated by BLEU, semantic similarity, and human evaluation, and also that the optimization procedure converges faster.

beyond bleu training neural machine tran.subject: semantic similarity reward function
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.claim: The optimization procedure using the proposed metric converges faster than when using BLEU.
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.quote: We evaluate on four disparate languages trans-lated to English, and find that training with our proposed metric results in better translations as evaluated by BLEU, semantic similarity, and human evaluation, and also that the optimization procedure converges faster.

beyond bleu training neural machine tran.subject: semantic similarity reward function
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.claim: The proposed metric is more conducive to optimization because it assigns partial credit and provides more diversity in scores than BLEU.
beyond bleu training neural machine tran.quote: Analysis suggests that this is because the proposed metric is more conducive to optimization, assigning partial credit and providing more diversity in scores than BLEU

unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.subject: Unsupervised Bilingual Word Embedding (UBWE)
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.claim: The performance of UNMT is significantly affected by the performance of UBWE.
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.quote: The empirical findings show that the performance of UNMT is significantly affected by the performance of UBWE.

unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.subject: UNMT with UBWE agreement
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.claim: The authors propose two methods that train UNMT with UBWE agreement.
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.quote: Thus, we propose two methods that train UNMT with UBWE agreement.

unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.subject: UNMT with UBWE agreement
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.claim: The proposed methods significantly outperform conventional UNMT on several language pairs.
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.quote: Empirical results on several language pairs show that the proposed methods significantly outperform conventional UNMT.

unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.subject: Unsupervised Bilingual Word Embedding (UBWE)
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.claim: UBWE is trained using non-parallel monolingual corpora and then used to initialize the word embedding in the encoder and decoder of UNMT.
unsupervised bilingual word embedding ag.quote: In previous methods, UBWE is first trained using non-parallel monolingual corpora and then this pre-trained UBWE is used to initialize the word embedding in the encoder and decoder of UNMT.

sequence generation from both sides to t.subject: SBSG
sequence generation from both sides to t.claim: The paper proposes a synchronous bidirectional sequence generation (SBSG) model which predicts its outputs from both sides to the middle simultaneously.
sequence generation from both sides to t.quote: To alleviate these issues, we propose a synchronous bidirectional sequence generation (SBSG) model which predicts its outputs from both sides to the middle simultaneously.

sequence generation from both sides to t.subject: interactive bidirectional attention network
sequence generation from both sides to t.claim: The SBSG model enables left-to-right and right-to-left generation to help and interact with each other by leveraging an interactive bidirectional attention network.
sequence generation from both sides to t.quote: In the SBSG model, we enable the left-to-right (L2R) and right-to-left (R2L) generation to help and interact with each other by leveraging interactive bidirectional attention network.

sequence generation from both sides to t.subject: SBSG
sequence generation from both sides to t.claim: Experiments on neural machine translation and text summarization tasks show that the proposed model significantly speeds up decoding while improving the generation quality compared to the autoregressive Transformer.
sequence generation from both sides to t.quote: Experiments on neural machine translation (En-De, Ch-En, and En-Ro) and text summarization tasks show that the proposed model significantly speeds up decoding while improving the generation quality compared to the autoregressive Transformer.

sequence generation from both sides to t.subject: autoregressive decoding procedure
sequence generation from both sides to t.claim: The autoregressive decoding procedure is time-consuming when the output sentence becomes longer.
sequence generation from both sides to t.quote: Such a framework usually generates a sequence token by token from left to right, hence (1) this autoregressive decoding procedure is time-consuming when the output sentence becomes longer, and (2) it lacks the guidance of future context which is crucial to avoid under-translation.

sequence generation from both sides to t.subject: autoregressive decoding procedure
sequence generation from both sides to t.claim: The autoregressive decoding procedure lacks the guidance of future context which is crucial to avoid under-translation.
sequence generation from both sides to t.quote: Such a framework usually generates a sequence token by token from left to right, hence (1) this autoregressive decoding procedure is time-consuming when the output sentence becomes longer, and (2) it lacks the guidance of future context which is crucial to avoid under-translation.

retrieving sequential information for no.subject: Reinforce-NAT
retrieving sequential information for no.claim: Reinforce-NAT is a sequence-level training method based on a novel reinforcement algorithm for NAT designed to reduce variance and stabilize the training procedure.
retrieving sequential information for no.quote: Firstly, we propose a sequence-level training method based on a novel reinforcement algorithm for NAT (Reinforce-NAT) to reduce the variance and stabilize the training procedure.

retrieving sequential information for no.subject: FS-decoder
retrieving sequential information for no.claim: FS-decoder is an innovative Transformer decoder that fuses target sequential information into the top layer of the decoder.
retrieving sequential information for no.quote: Secondly, we propose an innovative Transformer decoder named FS-decoder to fuse the target sequential information into the top layer of the decoder.

retrieving sequential information for no.subject: Reinforce-NAT
retrieving sequential information for no.claim: Reinforce-NAT surpasses the baseline NAT system by a significant margin on BLEU without decelerating the decoding speed.
retrieving sequential information for no.quote: Experimental results on three translation tasks show that the Reinforce-NAT surpasses the baseline NAT system by a significant margin on BLEU without decelerating the decoding speed and the FS-decoder achieves comparable translation performance to the autoregressive Transformer with considerable speedup.

retrieving sequential information for no.subject: FS-decoder
retrieving sequential information for no.claim: FS-decoder achieves comparable translation performance to the autoregressive Transformer with considerable speedup.
retrieving sequential information for no.quote: Experimental results on three translation tasks show that the Reinforce-NAT surpasses the baseline NAT system by a significant margin on BLEU without decelerating the decoding speed and the FS-decoder achieves comparable translation performance to the autoregressive Transformer with considerable speedup.

retrieving sequential information for no.subject: Non-Autoregressive Transformer
retrieving sequential information for no.claim: Non-Autoregressive Transformer fails to exploit target sequential information, which often leads to over-translation and under-translation errors, especially in long sentence translation scenarios.
retrieving sequential information for no.quote: Non-Autoregressive Transformer (NAT) aims to accelerate the Transformer model through discarding the autoregressive mechanism and generating target words independently, which fails to exploit the target sequential information. Over-translation and under-translation errors often occur for the above reason, especially in the long sentence translation scenario.

tagged back translation.subject: noised-beam decoding
tagged back translation.claim: The main role of synthetic noise in back-translation is to indicate to the model that the given source is synthetic, rather than to diversify the source side.
tagged back translation.quote: We show that the main role of such synthetic noise is not to diversify the source side, as previously suggested, but simply to indicate to the model that the given source is synthetic.

tagged back translation.subject: Tagged Back-Translation
tagged back translation.claim: The proposed method consists of tagging back-translated source sentences with an extra token as a simpler alternative to noising techniques.
tagged back translation.quote: We propose a simpler alternative to noising techniques, consisting of tagging back-translated source sentences with an extra token.

tagged back translation.subject: Tagged Back-Translation
tagged back translation.claim: Results on WMT show that the proposed method outperforms noised back-translation in English-Romanian and matches performance on English-German.
tagged back translation.quote: Our results on WMT outperform noised back-translation in English-Romanian and match performance on English-German, redefining the state-of-the-art on the former.

what does bert look at an analysis of be.subject: methods for analyzing the attention mechanisms of pre-trained models
what does bert look at an analysis of be.claim: The authors propose methods for analyzing the attention mechanisms of pre-trained models and apply them to BERT.
what does bert look at an analysis of be.quote: Complementary to these works, we propose methods for analyzing the attention mechanisms of pre-trained models and apply them to BERT.

what does bert look at an analysis of be.subject: BERT
what does bert look at an analysis of be.claim: BERT’s attention heads exhibit patterns such as attending to delimiter tokens, specific positional offsets, or broadly attending over the whole sentence, with heads in the same layer often exhibiting similar behaviors.
what does bert look at an analysis of be.quote: BERT’s attention heads exhibit patterns such as attending to delimiter tokens, specific positional offsets, or broadly attending over the whole sentence, with heads in the same layer often exhibiting similar behaviors.

what does bert look at an analysis of be.subject: BERT
what does bert look at an analysis of be.claim: Certain attention heads in BERT correspond well to linguistic notions of syntax and coreference.
what does bert look at an analysis of be.quote: We further show that certain attention heads correspond well to linguistic notions of syntax and coreference.

what does bert look at an analysis of be.subject: BERT
what does bert look at an analysis of be.claim: Specific heads in BERT attend to direct objects of verbs, determiners of nouns, objects of prepositions, and coreferent mentions with remarkably high accuracy.
what does bert look at an analysis of be.quote: For example, we find heads that attend to the direct objects of verbs, determiners of nouns, objects of prepositions, and coreferent mentions with remarkably high accuracy.

what does bert look at an analysis of be.subject: attention-based probing classifier
what does bert look at an analysis of be.claim: The authors propose an attention-based probing classifier to demonstrate that substantial syntactic information is captured in BERT’s attention.
what does bert look at an analysis of be.quote: Lastly, we propose an attention-based probing classifier and use it to further demonstrate that substantial syntactic information is captured in BERT’s attention.

what does bert look at an analysis of be.subject: BERT
what does bert look at an analysis of be.claim: Substantial syntactic information is captured in BERT’s attention.
what does bert look at an analysis of be.quote: Lastly, we propose an attention-based probing classifier and use it to further demonstrate that substantial syntactic information is captured in BERT’s attention.

shared private bilingual word embeddings.subject: shared-private bilingual word embeddings
shared private bilingual word embeddings.claim: The paper proposes shared-private bilingual word embeddings to give a closer relationship between source and target embeddings and reduce the number of model parameters.
shared private bilingual word embeddings.quote: In this paper, we propose shared-private bilingual word embeddings, which give a closer relationship between the source and target embeddings, and which also reduce the number of model parameters.

shared private bilingual word embeddings.subject: shared-private bilingual word embeddings
shared private bilingual word embeddings.claim: For similar source and target words, their embeddings tend to share a part of the features and they cooperatively learn these common representation units.
shared private bilingual word embeddings.quote: For similar source and target words, their embeddings tend to share a part of the features and they cooperatively learn these common representation units.

shared private bilingual word embeddings.subject: shared-private bilingual word embeddings
shared private bilingual word embeddings.claim: Experiments on 5 language pairs belonging to 6 different language families and written in 5 different alphabets demonstrate that the proposed model provides a significant performance boost over the strong baselines with dramatically fewer model parameters.
shared private bilingual word embeddings.quote: Experiments on 5 language pairs belonging to 6 different language families and written in 5 different alphabets demonstrate that the proposed model provides a significant performance boost over the strong baselines with dramatically fewer model parameters.

robust neural machine translation with d.subject: Robust Neural Machine Translation with Doubly Adversarial Inputs
robust neural machine translation with d.claim: The proposed approach consists of attacking the translation model with adversarial source examples and defending it with adversarial target inputs to improve robustness.
robust neural machine translation with d.quote: We propose an approach to improving the robustness of NMT models, which consists of two parts: (1) attack the translation model with adversarial source examples; (2) defend the translation model with adversarial target inputs to improve its robustness against the adversarial source inputs.

robust neural machine translation with d.subject: gradient-based method
robust neural machine translation with d.claim: A gradient-based method is proposed to craft adversarial examples informed by the translation loss over the clean inputs.
robust neural machine translation with d.quote: For the generation of adversarial inputs, we propose a gradient-based method to craft adversarial examples informed by the translation loss over the clean inputs.

robust neural machine translation with d.subject: Robust Neural Machine Translation with Doubly Adversarial Inputs
robust neural machine translation with d.claim: The approach achieves significant improvements of 2.8 and 1.6 BLEU points over Transformer on standard clean benchmarks for Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks.
robust neural machine translation with d.quote: Experimental results on Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks demonstrate that our approach achieves significant improvements (2.8 and 1.6 BLEU points) over Transformer on standard clean benchmarks as well as exhibiting higher robustness on noisy data.

robust neural machine translation with d.subject: Robust Neural Machine Translation with Doubly Adversarial Inputs
robust neural machine translation with d.claim: The approach exhibits higher robustness on noisy data compared to the baseline.
robust neural machine translation with d.quote: Experimental results on Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks demonstrate that our approach achieves significant improvements (2.8 and 1.6 BLEU points) over Transformer on standard clean benchmarks as well as exhibiting higher robustness on noisy data.

robust neural machine translation with d.subject: Neural machine translation
robust neural machine translation with d.claim: Neural machine translation models often suffer from vulnerability to noisy perturbations in the input.
robust neural machine translation with d.quote: Neural machine translation (NMT) often suffers from the vulnerability to noisy perturbations in the input.

syntactically supervised transformers fo.subject: SynST
syntactically supervised transformers fo.claim: SynST first autoregressively predicts a chunked parse tree before generating all of the target tokens in one shot conditioned on the predicted parse.
syntactically supervised transformers fo.quote: In this work, we propose the syntactically supervised Transformer (SynST), which first autoregressively predicts a chunked parse tree before generating all of the target tokens in one shot conditioned on the predicted parse.

syntactically supervised transformers fo.subject: SynST
syntactically supervised transformers fo.claim: SynST decodes sentences ~5x faster than the baseline autoregressive Transformer while achieving higher BLEU scores than most competing methods on En-De and En-Fr datasets.
syntactically supervised transformers fo.quote: A series of controlled experiments demonstrates that SynST decodes sentences ~5x faster than the baseline autoregressive Transformer while achieving higher BLEU scores than most competing methods on En-De and En-Fr datasets.

syntactically supervised transformers fo.subject: non- and semi-autoregressive decoding
syntactically supervised transformers fo.claim: Recent developments in non- and semi-autoregressive decoding improve inference speed but deteriorate translation quality.
syntactically supervised transformers fo.quote: Recent developments in non- and semi-autoregressive decoding produce multiple tokens per timestep independently of the others, which improves inference speed but deteriorates translation quality.

imitation learning for non autoregressiv.subject: imitation learning framework for non-autoregressive machine translation
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.claim: The paper proposes an imitation learning framework for non-autoregressive machine translation that enjoys fast translation speed but gives comparable translation performance compared to its auto-regressive counterpart.
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.quote: In this paper, we propose an imitation learning framework for non-autoregressive machine translation, which still enjoys the fast translation speed but gives comparable translation performance compared to its auto-regressive counterpart.

imitation learning for non autoregressiv.subject: existing NAT algorithms
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.claim: A potential issue of the existing NAT algorithms is that the decoding is conducted in parallel, without directly considering previous context.
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.quote: A potential issue of the existing NAT algorithms, however, is that the decoding is conducted in parallel, without directly considering previous context.

imitation learning for non autoregressiv.subject: proposed model
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.claim: The proposed model achieves a significant speedup over the autoregressive models, while keeping the translation quality comparable to the autoregressive models.
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.quote: Our proposed model achieves a significant speedup over the autoregressive models, while keeping the translation quality comparable to the autoregressive models.

imitation learning for non autoregressiv.subject: proposed model
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.claim: By sampling sentence length in parallel at inference time, the model achieves the performance of 31.85 BLEU on WMT16 Ro->En and 30.68 BLEU on IWSLT16 En->De.
imitation learning for non autoregressiv.quote: By sampling sentence length in parallel at inference time, we achieve the performance of 31.85 BLEU on WMT16 Ro\rightarrowEn and 30.68 BLEU on IWSLT16 En\rightarrowDe.

mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.subject: MASS
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.claim: MASS adopts the encoder-decoder framework to reconstruct a sentence fragment given the remaining part of the sentence.
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.quote: MASS adopts the encoder-decoder framework to reconstruct a sentence fragment given the remaining part of the sentence: its encoder takes a sentence with randomly masked fragment (several consecutive tokens) as input, and its decoder tries to predict this masked fragment.

mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.subject: MASS
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.claim: MASS can jointly train the encoder and decoder to develop the capability of representation extraction and language modeling.
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.quote: In this way, MASS can jointly train the encoder and decoder to develop the capability of representation extraction and language modeling.

mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.subject: MASS
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.claim: MASS achieves significant improvements over the baselines without pre-training or with other pre-training methods on zero/low-resource language generation tasks.
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.quote: By further fine-tuning on a variety of zero/low-resource language generation tasks, including neural machine translation, text summarization and conversational response generation (3 tasks and totally 8 datasets), MASS achieves significant improvements over the baselines without pre-training or with other pre-training methods.

mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.subject: MASS
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.claim: MASS achieves the state-of-the-art accuracy of 37.5 in terms of BLEU score on the unsupervised English-French translation.
mass masked sequence to sequence pre tra.quote: Specially, we achieve the state-of-the-art accuracy (37.5 in terms of BLEU score) on the unsupervised English-French translation, even beating the early attention-based supervised model.

synchronous bidirectional neural machine.subject: SB-NMT
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.claim: The paper introduces a synchronous bidirectional–neural machine translation (SB-NMT) that predicts its outputs using left-to-right and right-to-left decoding simultaneously and interactively.
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.quote: In this paper, we introduce a synchronous bidirectional–neural machine translation (SB-NMT) that predicts its outputs using left-to-right and right-to-left decoding simultaneously and interactively, in order to leverage both of the history and future information at the same time.

synchronous bidirectional neural machine.subject: SB-NMT
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.claim: The model presents an interactive decoding mechanism where generation relies on future contexts predicted by the opposite decoding direction.
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.quote: Then, we present an interactive decoding model in which left-to-right (right-to-left) generation does not only depend on its previously generated outputs, but also relies on future contexts predicted by right-to-left (left-to-right) decoding.

synchronous bidirectional neural machine.subject: SB-NMT
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.claim: The model achieves significant improvements over the strong Transformer model by 3.92, 1.49, and 1.04 BLEU points on NIST Chinese–English, WMT14 English–German, and WMT18 Russian–English tasks, respectively.
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.quote: Experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves significant improvements over the strong Transformer model by 3.92, 1.49, and 1.04 BLEU points, respectively, and obtains the state-of-the-art performance on Chinese–English and English–German translation tasks.

synchronous bidirectional neural machine.subject: unidirectional decoding framework
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.claim: Existing unidirectional decoding frameworks cannot make full use of target-side future contexts and suffer from the issue of unbalanced outputs.
synchronous bidirectional neural machine.quote: However, this kind of unidirectional decoding framework cannot make full use of the target-side future contexts which can be produced in a right-to-left decoding direction, and thus suffers from the issue of unbalanced outputs.

fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.subject: fairseq
fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.claim: fairseq is an open-source sequence modeling toolkit that allows researchers and developers to train custom models for translation, summarization, language modeling, and other text generation tasks.
fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.quote: fairseq is an open-source sequence modeling toolkit that allows researchers and developers to train custom models for translation, summarization, language modeling, and other text generation tasks.

fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.subject: fairseq
fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.claim: The toolkit is based on PyTorch and supports distributed training across multiple GPUs and machines.
fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.quote: The toolkit is based on PyTorch and supports distributed training across multiple GPUs and machines.

fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.subject: fairseq
fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.claim: The toolkit supports fast mixed-precision training and inference on modern GPUs.
fairseq a fast extensible toolkit for se.quote: We also support fast mixed-precision training and inference on modern GPUs.

extract and edit an alternative to back.subject: extract-edit
extract and edit an alternative to back.claim: The paper proposes an alternative approach called extract-edit to extract and then edit real sentences from target monolingual corpora.
extract and edit an alternative to back.quote: To avoid this fundamental issue, we propose an alternative but more effective approach, extract-edit, to extract and then edit real sentences from the target monolingual corpora.

extract and edit an alternative to back.subject: comparative translation loss
extract and edit an alternative to back.claim: The authors introduce a comparative translation loss to evaluate translated target sentences and train unsupervised translation systems.
extract and edit an alternative to back.quote: Furthermore, we introduce a comparative translation loss to evaluate the translated target sentences and thus train the unsupervised translation systems.

extract and edit an alternative to back.subject: extract-edit
extract and edit an alternative to back.claim: The proposed approach consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art unsupervised machine translation systems by more than 2 BLEU points across four language pairs.
extract and edit an alternative to back.quote: Experiments show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms the previous state-of-the-art unsupervised machine translation systems across two benchmarks (English-French and English-German) and two low-resource language pairs (English-Romanian and English-Russian) by more than 2 (up to 3.63) BLEU points.

extract and edit an alternative to back.subject: Back-translation
