regularizing forward and backward decodi.subject: Regularizing Forward and Backward Decoding
regularizing forward and backward decodi.claim: The proposed method uses a regularization loss to encourage the NMT decoder to exploit bidirectional information of target sentences by training extra backward decoding components and enforcing connections between forward and backward hidden states.
regularizing forward and backward decodi.quote: We propose to use a regularization loss to encourage NMT decoder to exploit bidirectional information of target sentences. Beside of forward decoding, we train an extra set of decoding components to predict translation from backward, and use regularization to enforce the forward and backward hidden states at the same time step have connection.

regularizing forward and backward decodi.subject: Regularizing Forward and Backward Decoding
regularizing forward and backward decodi.claim: The approach significantly improves performance on WMT German-English and English-Chinese translation tasks in terms of NIST and BLEU scores.
regularizing forward and backward decodi.quote: Our empirical experiments demonstrated that our approach can significantly improve the performance on WMT German-English and English-Chinese translation tasks in terms of NIST and BLEU score.

regularizing forward and backward decodi.subject: RNN based sequential decoder
regularizing forward and backward decodi.claim: The common RNN based sequential decoder can only translate from one direction, which causes the model to overfit in the forward direction and leaves backward information of target sentences unexploited.
regularizing forward and backward decodi.quote: The common recurrent neural network (RNN) based sequential decoder of the neural machine translation (NMT) model can only translate from one direction, which makes the model overfit in the forward direction and leaves backward information of target sentences unexploited.

middle out decoding.subject: middle-out decoder
middle out decoding.claim: The paper proposes a novel middle-out decoder architecture that begins from an initial middle-word and simultaneously expands the sequence in both directions.
middle out decoding.quote: To address this issue, we propose a novel middle-out decoder architecture that begins from an initial middle-word and simultaneously expands the sequence in both directions.

middle out decoding.subject: dual self-attention mechanism
middle out decoding.claim: A dual self-attention mechanism is introduced to facilitate information flow and maintain consistent decoding by modeling complex dependencies between outputs.
middle out decoding.quote: To facilitate information flow and maintain consistent decoding, we introduce a dual self-attention mechanism that allows us to model complex dependencies between the outputs.

middle out decoding.subject: middle-out decoder
middle out decoding.claim: The middle-out decoder achieves significant improvements on de-noising and competitive performance in video captioning while quantifiably improving caption diversity.
middle out decoding.quote: Our middle-out decoder achieves significant improvements on de-noising and competitive performance in the task of video captioning, while quantifiably improving the caption diversity.

middle out decoding.subject: middle-out decoder
middle out decoding.claim: Qualitative analysis demonstrates the ability to effectively control the generation process of the decoder.
middle out decoding.quote: Furthermore, we perform a qualitative analysis that demonstrates our ability to effectively control the generation process of our decoder.

middle out decoding.subject: sequence-to-sequence models
middle out decoding.claim: Sequence-to-sequence models are challenged by their lack of diversity and inability to be externally controlled.
middle out decoding.quote: Despite being virtually ubiquitous, sequence-to-sequence models are challenged by their lack of diversity and inability to be externally controlled.

robust neural machine translation with j.subject: Joint textual and phonetic embedding with homophone noise augmentation
robust neural machine translation with j.claim: The paper proposes to improve the robustness of NMT to homophone noises by jointly embedding both textual and phonetic information of source sentences and augmenting the training dataset with homophone noises.
robust neural machine translation with j.quote: We propose to improve the robustness of NMT to homophone noises by 1) jointly embedding both textual and phonetic information of source sentences, and 2) augmenting the training dataset with homophone noises.

robust neural machine translation with j.subject: Joint textual and phonetic embedding with homophone noise augmentation
robust neural machine translation with j.claim: To achieve better translation quality and more robustness, most weights should be put on the phonetic rather than textual information.
robust neural machine translation with j.quote: Interestingly, to achieve better translation quality and more robustness, we found that most (though not all) weights should be put on the phonetic rather than textual information.

robust neural machine translation with j.subject: Joint textual and phonetic embedding with homophone noise augmentation
robust neural machine translation with j.claim: The method significantly improves the robustness of NMT to homophone noises and surprisingly improves the translation quality on some clean test sets.
robust neural machine translation with j.quote: Experiments show that our method not only significantly improves the robustness of NMT to homophone noises, but also surprisingly improves the translation quality on some clean test sets.

identifying and controlling important ne.subject: unsupervised methods for discovering important neurons
identifying and controlling important ne.claim: The authors develop unsupervised methods for discovering important neurons in NMT models that rely on the intuition that different models learn similar properties and do not require costly external supervision.
identifying and controlling important ne.quote: We develop unsupervised methods for discovering important neurons in NMT models. Our methods rely on the intuition that different models learn similar properties, and do not require any costly external supervision.

identifying and controlling important ne.subject: discovered neurons
identifying and controlling important ne.claim: Translation quality depends on the discovered neurons.
identifying and controlling important ne.quote: We show experimentally that translation quality depends on the discovered neurons, and find that many of them capture common linguistic phenomena.

identifying and controlling important ne.subject: discovered neurons
identifying and controlling important ne.claim: Many of the discovered neurons capture common linguistic phenomena.
identifying and controlling important ne.quote: We show experimentally that translation quality depends on the discovered neurons, and find that many of them capture common linguistic phenomena.

identifying and controlling important ne.subject: NMT translations
identifying and controlling important ne.claim: NMT translations can be controlled in predictable ways by modifying activations of individual neurons.
identifying and controlling important ne.quote: Finally, we show how to control NMT translations in predictable ways, by modifying activations of individual neurons.

von mises fisher loss for training seque.subject: Von Mises-Fisher Loss
von mises fisher loss for training seque.claim: The paper proposes a novel probabilistic loss for training sequence-to-sequence models with continuous outputs.
von mises fisher loss for training seque.quote: Our primary innovations are a novel probabilistic loss, and a training and inference procedure in which we generate a probability distribution over pre-trained word embeddings, instead of a multinomial distribution over the vocabulary obtained via softmax.

von mises fisher loss for training seque.subject: Continuous embedding layer
von mises fisher loss for training seque.claim: The authors propose a general technique for replacing the softmax layer with a continuous embedding layer.
von mises fisher loss for training seque.quote: We propose a general technique for replacing the softmax layer with a continuous embedding layer.

von mises fisher loss for training seque.subject: Von Mises-Fisher Loss
von mises fisher loss for training seque.claim: Models using this method obtain up to 2.5x speed-up in training time while performing on par with state-of-the-art models in translation quality.
von mises fisher loss for training seque.quote: We show that our models obtain upto 2.5x speed-up in training time while performing on par with the state-of-the-art models in terms of translation quality.

von mises fisher loss for training seque.subject: Von Mises-Fisher Loss
von mises fisher loss for training seque.claim: The models are capable of handling very large vocabularies without compromising on translation quality.
von mises fisher loss for training seque.quote: These models are capable of handling very large vocabularies without compromising on translation quality.

von mises fisher loss for training seque.subject: Von Mises-Fisher Loss
von mises fisher loss for training seque.claim: The models produce more meaningful errors than softmax-based models, as these errors typically lie in a subspace of the vector space of the reference translations.
von mises fisher loss for training seque.quote: They also produce more meaningful errors than in the softmax-based models, as these errors typically lie in a subspace of the vector space of the reference translations.

von mises fisher loss for training seque.subject: Softmax function
von mises fisher loss for training seque.claim: The Softmax function is usually the slowest layer to compute, which limits the vocabulary size to a subset of most frequent types, and it has a large memory footprint.
von mises fisher loss for training seque.quote: However, it is usually the slowest layer to compute which limits the vocabulary size to a subset of most frequent types; and it has a large memory footprint.

top down tree structured decoding with s.subject: Seq2DRNN
top down tree structured decoding with s.claim: Seq2DRNN is an NMT model that combines a sequential encoder with tree-structured decoding augmented with a syntax-aware attention model.
top down tree structured decoding with s.quote: We exploit a top-down tree-structured model called DRNN (Doubly-Recurrent Neural Networks) first proposed by Alvarez-Melis and Jaakola (2017) to create an NMT model called Seq2DRNN that combines a sequential encoder with tree-structured decoding augmented with a syntax-aware attention model.

top down tree structured decoding with s.subject: Seq2DRNN+SynC
top down tree structured decoding with s.claim: Seq2DRNN+SynC uses the syntactic structure of the sentence to add new connections to the tree-structured decoder neural network.
top down tree structured decoding with s.quote: In addition, we use the syntactic structure of the sentence to add new connections to the tree-structured decoder neural network (Seq2DRNN+SynC).

top down tree structured decoding with s.subject: Seq2DRNN
top down tree structured decoding with s.claim: The model produces more fluent translations with better reordering compared to sequential and state of the art syntax-based NMT models.
top down tree structured decoding with s.quote: We compare our NMT model with sequential and state of the art syntax-based NMT models and show that our model produces more fluent translations with better reordering.

top down tree structured decoding with s.subject: Seq2DRNN
top down tree structured decoding with s.claim: The model is capable of doing translation and constituency parsing at the same time.
top down tree structured decoding with s.quote: Since our model is capable of doing translation and constituency parsing at the same time we also compare our parsing accuracy against other neural parsing models.

top down tree structured decoding with s.subject: constituency parsing
top down tree structured decoding with s.claim: The authors argue that constituency parsing provides useful information for translation, unlike previous approaches which use dependency parsing models.
top down tree structured decoding with s.quote: Unlike previous approaches to syntax-based NMT which use dependency parsing models our method uses constituency parsing which we argue provides useful information for translation.

unsupervised statistical machine transla.subject: Unsupervised Statistical Machine Translation
unsupervised statistical machine transla.claim: The paper proposes an alternative approach based on phrase-based Statistical Machine Translation (SMT) that significantly closes the gap with supervised systems.
unsupervised statistical machine transla.quote: In this paper, we propose an alternative approach based on phrase-based Statistical Machine Translation (SMT) that significantly closes the gap with supervised systems.

unsupervised statistical machine transla.subject: Unsupervised Statistical Machine Translation
unsupervised statistical machine transla.claim: The method induces a phrase table from monolingual corpora through cross-lingual embedding mappings, combines it with an n-gram language model, and fine-tunes hyperparameters through an unsupervised MERT variant.
unsupervised statistical machine transla.quote: Our method profits from the modular architecture of SMT: we first induce a phrase table from monolingual corpora through cross-lingual embedding mappings, combine it with an n-gram language model, and fine-tune hyperparameters through an unsupervised MERT variant.

unsupervised statistical machine transla.subject: Unsupervised Statistical Machine Translation
unsupervised statistical machine transla.claim: The proposed system yields 14.08 and 26.22 BLEU points in WMT 2014 English-German and English-French, respectively.
unsupervised statistical machine transla.quote: In addition, iterative backtranslation improves results further, yielding, for instance, 14.08 and 26.22 BLEU points in WMT 2014 English-German and English-French, respectively, an improvement of more than 7-10 BLEU points over previous unsupervised systems, and closing the gap with supervised SMT (Moses trained on Europarl) down to 2-5 BLEU points.

unsupervised statistical machine transla.subject: Unsupervised Statistical Machine Translation
unsupervised statistical machine transla.claim: The proposed approach improves results by more than 7-10 BLEU points over previous unsupervised systems.
unsupervised statistical machine transla.quote: In addition, iterative backtranslation improves results further, yielding, for instance, 14.08 and 26.22 BLEU points in WMT 2014 English-German and English-French, respectively, an improvement of more than 7-10 BLEU points over previous unsupervised systems, and closing the gap with supervised SMT (Moses trained on Europarl) down to 2-5 BLEU points.

unsupervised statistical machine transla.subject: existing unsupervised NMT systems
unsupervised statistical machine transla.claim: Existing unsupervised systems are far behind their supervised counterparts, limiting their practical interest.
unsupervised statistical machine transla.quote: Despite the potential of this approach for low-resource settings, existing systems are far behind their supervised counterparts, limiting their practical interest.

mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.subject: MTNT
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.claim: The paper proposes a benchmark dataset for Machine Translation of Noisy Text (MTNT) consisting of noisy comments on Reddit and professionally sourced translations.
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.quote: In this paper, we propose a benchmark dataset for Machine Translation of Noisy Text (MTNT), consisting of noisy comments on Reddit (www.reddit.com) and professionally sourced translations.

mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.subject: MTNT
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.claim: The dataset includes translations of English comments into French and Japanese, as well as French and Japanese comments into English, with 7k-37k sentences per language pair.
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.quote: We commissioned translations of English comments into French and Japanese, as well as French and Japanese comments into English, on the order of 7k-37k sentences per language pair.

mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.subject: existing MT models
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.claim: Existing MT models fail badly on a number of noise-related phenomena, even after performing adaptation on a small training set of in-domain data.
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.quote: then demonstrate that existing MT models fail badly on a number of noise-related phenomena, even after performing adaptation on a small training set of in-domain data.

mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.subject: previous work
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.claim: Previous work has resorted to evaluating on synthetically created datasets because there are no publicly available parallel corpora with naturally occurring noisy inputs and translations.
mtnt a testbed for machine translation o.quote: However, as of yet there are no publicly available parallel corpora of with naturally occurring noisy inputs and translations, and thus previous work has resorted to evaluating on synthetically created datasets.

revisiting character based neural machin.subject: deep character baseline model
revisiting character based neural machin.claim: Deep models operating at the character level outperform identical models operating over word fragments.
revisiting character based neural machin.quote: This result implies that alternative architectures for handling character input are better viewed as methods for reducing computation time than as improved ways of modeling longer sequences.

revisiting character based neural machin.subject: standard sequence-to-sequence architectures
revisiting character based neural machin.claim: The modeling problem of character-level NMT can be solved by standard sequence-to-sequence architectures of sufficient depth.
revisiting character based neural machin.quote: In this paper, we show that the modeling problem can be solved by standard sequence-to-sequence architectures of sufficient depth, and that deep models operating at the character level outperform identical models operating over word fragments.

revisiting character based neural machin.subject: alternative architectures for handling character input
revisiting character based neural machin.claim: Alternative architectures for handling character input are better viewed as methods for reducing computation time than as improved ways of modeling longer sequences.
revisiting character based neural machin.quote: This result implies that alternative architectures for handling character input are better viewed as methods for reducing computation time than as improved ways of modeling longer sequences.

revisiting character based neural machin.subject: techniques for character-level NMT
revisiting character based neural machin.claim: Several techniques for character-level NMT do not match the performance of the deep character baseline model.
revisiting character based neural machin.quote: From this perspective, we evaluate several techniques for character-level NMT, verify that they do not match the performance of our deep character baseline model, and evaluate the performance versus computation time tradeoffs they offer.

revisiting character based neural machin.subject: conditional computation over time
revisiting character based neural machin.claim: The paper performs the first evaluation for NMT of conditional computation over time, in which the model learns which timesteps can be skipped.
revisiting character based neural machin.quote: Within this framework, we also perform the first evaluation for NMT of conditional computation over time, in which the model learns which timesteps can be skipped, rather than having them be dictated by a fixed schedule specified before training begins.

a study of reinforcement learning for ne.subject: Reinforcement Learning (RL)
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.claim: Reinforcement learning is an effective approach for improving the performance of neural machine translation systems.
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.quote: Recent studies have shown that reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective approach for improving the performance of neural machine translation (NMT) system.

a study of reinforcement learning for ne.subject: Reinforcement Learning (RL)
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.claim: Successfully training with reinforcement learning is challenging due to its instability, especially in real-world systems using deep models and large datasets.
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.quote: However, due to its instability, successfully RL training is challenging, especially in real-world systems where deep models and large datasets are leveraged.

a study of reinforcement learning for ne.subject: Systematic study on RL for NMT
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.claim: The paper conducts a systematic study on how to train better NMT models using reinforcement learning by comparing factors like baseline reward and reward shaping.
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.quote: In this paper, taking several large-scale translation tasks as testbeds, we conduct a systematic study on how to train better NMT models using reinforcement learning. We provide a comprehensive comparison of several important factors (e.g., baseline reward, reward shaping) in RL training.

a study of reinforcement learning for ne.subject: RL with monolingual data
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.claim: The authors propose a new method to leverage reinforcement learning to boost the performance of NMT systems trained with source/target monolingual data.
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.quote: Furthermore, to fill in the gap that it remains unclear whether RL is still beneficial when monolingual data is used, we propose a new method to leverage RL to further boost the performance of NMT systems trained with source/target monolingual data.

a study of reinforcement learning for ne.subject: Integrated RL-NMT findings
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.claim: Integrating the study's findings yields competitive results on WMT14 English-German, WMT17 English-Chinese, and WMT17 Chinese-English tasks, setting a state-of-the-art performance on WMT17 Chinese-English.
a study of reinforcement learning for ne.quote: By integrating all our findings, we obtain competitive results on WMT14 English-German, WMT17 English-Chinese, and WMT17 Chinese-English translation tasks, especially setting a state-of-the-art performance on WMT17 Chinese-English translation task.

semi autoregressive neural machine trans.subject: semi-autoregressive Transformer (SAT)
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.claim: The SAT keeps the autoregressive property in global but relieves in local and thus are able to produce multiple successive words in parallel at each time step.
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.quote: The SAT keeps the autoregressive property in global but relieves in local and thus are able to produce multiple successive words in parallel at each time step.

semi autoregressive neural machine trans.subject: semi-autoregressive Transformer (SAT)
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.claim: On WMT’14 English-German translation, the SAT achieves 5.58× speedup while maintaining 88% translation quality, significantly better than the previous non-autoregressive methods.
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.quote: On WMT’14 English-German translation, the SAT achieves 5.58× speedup while maintaining 88% translation quality, significantly better than the previous non-autoregressive methods.

semi autoregressive neural machine trans.subject: semi-autoregressive Transformer (SAT)
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.claim: When produces two words at each time step, the SAT is almost lossless (only 1% degeneration in BLEU score).
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.quote: When produces two words at each time step, the SAT is almost lossless (only 1% degeneration in BLEU score).

semi autoregressive neural machine trans.subject: autoregressive models
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.claim: Existing approaches to neural machine translation are typically autoregressive models... suffering from low parallelizability and thus slow at decoding long sequences.
semi autoregressive neural machine trans.quote: Existing approaches to neural machine translation are typically autoregressive models. While these models attain state-of-the-art translation quality, they are suffering from low parallelizability and thus slow at decoding long sequences.

regularizing neural machine translation.subject: target-bidirectional agreement regularization
regularizing neural machine translation.claim: The paper proposes a novel model regularization method for NMT training that aims to improve the agreement between translations generated by left-to-right (L2R) and right-to-left (R2L) NMT decoders.
regularizing neural machine translation.quote: To address this issue, we propose a novel model regularization method for NMT training, which aims to improve the agreement between translations generated by left-to-right (L2R) and right-to-left (R2L) NMT decoders.

regularizing neural machine translation.subject: KL divergence regularization
regularizing neural machine translation.claim: The goal of improving agreement is achieved by introducing two Kullback-Leibler divergence regularization terms into the NMT training objective to reduce the mismatch between output probabilities of L2R and R2L models.
regularizing neural machine translation.quote: This goal is achieved by introducing two Kullback-Leibler divergence regularization terms into the NMT training objective to reduce the mismatch between output probabilities of L2R and R2L models.

regularizing neural machine translation.subject: joint training strategy
regularizing neural machine translation.claim: A joint training strategy is employed to allow L2R and R2L models to improve each other in an interactive update process.
regularizing neural machine translation.quote: In addition, we also employ a joint training strategy to allow L2R and R2L models to improve each other in an interactive update process.

regularizing neural machine translation.subject: target-bidirectional agreement regularization
regularizing neural machine translation.claim: The proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks.
regularizing neural machine translation.quote: Experimental results show that our proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on Chinese-English and English-German translation tasks.

regularizing neural machine translation.subject: Neural Machine Translation
regularizing neural machine translation.claim: Most NMT systems suffer from a fundamental shortcoming where errors made early in the generation process are fed as inputs to the model and can be quickly amplified, harming subsequent sequence generation.
regularizing neural machine translation.quote: Although Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved remarkable progress in the past several years, most NMT systems still suffer from a fundamental shortcoming as in other sequence generation tasks: errors made early in generation process are fed as inputs to the model and can be quickly amplified, harming subsequent sequence generation.

a tree based decoder for neural machine.subject: Tree-based Decoder for Neural Machine Translation
a tree based decoder for neural machine.claim: The paper proposes an NMT model that can naturally generate the topology of an arbitrary tree structure on the target side.
a tree based decoder for neural machine.quote: In this paper, we (1) propose an NMT model that can naturally generate the topology of an arbitrary tree structure on the target side, and (2) experiment with various target tree structures.

a tree based decoder for neural machine.subject: Tree-based Decoder for Neural Machine Translation
a tree based decoder for neural machine.claim: The model delivers the best improvements with balanced binary trees constructed without any linguistic knowledge.
a tree based decoder for neural machine.quote: Our experiments show the surprising result that our model delivers the best improvements with balanced binary trees constructed without any linguistic knowledge; this model outperforms standard seq2seq models by up to 2.1 BLEU points, and other methods for incorporating target-side syntax by up to 0.7 BLEU.

a tree based decoder for neural machine.subject: Tree-based Decoder for Neural Machine Translation
a tree based decoder for neural machine.claim: The proposed model outperforms standard seq2seq models by up to 2.1 BLEU points.
a tree based decoder for neural machine.quote: Our experiments show the surprising result that our model delivers the best improvements with balanced binary trees constructed without any linguistic knowledge; this model outperforms standard seq2seq models by up to 2.1 BLEU points, and other methods for incorporating target-side syntax by up to 0.7 BLEU.

a tree based decoder for neural machine.subject: Tree-based Decoder for Neural Machine Translation
a tree based decoder for neural machine.claim: The proposed model outperforms other methods for incorporating target-side syntax by up to 0.7 BLEU.
a tree based decoder for neural machine.quote: Our experiments show the surprising result that our model delivers the best improvements with balanced binary trees constructed without any linguistic knowledge; this model outperforms standard seq2seq models by up to 2.1 BLEU points, and other methods for incorporating target-side syntax by up to 0.7 BLEU.
mentions: other methods for incorporating target-side syntax

a tree based decoder for neural machine.subject: Neural Machine Translation
a tree based decoder for neural machine.claim: It is an open question of what specific linguistic formalism, if any, is the best structural representation for NMT.
a tree based decoder for neural machine.quote: However, it is an open question of what specific linguistic formalism, if any, is the best structural representation for NMT.

an operation sequence model for explaina.subject: Operation Sequence Model
an operation sequence model for explaina.claim: The proposed approach generates the target sentence by monotonically walking through the source sentence.
an operation sequence model for explaina.quote: We present a novel approach to NMT which generates the target sentence by monotonically walking through the source sentence.

an operation sequence model for explaina.subject: Operation Sequence Model
an operation sequence model for explaina.claim: Word reordering is modeled by operations which allow setting markers in the target sentence and move a target-side write head between those markers.
an operation sequence model for explaina.quote: Word reordering is modeled by operations which allow setting markers in the target sentence and move a target-side write head between those markers.

an operation sequence model for explaina.subject: Operation Sequence Model
an operation sequence model for explaina.claim: The system emits explicit word alignment information which improves explainability.
an operation sequence model for explaina.quote: In contrast to many modern neural models, our system emits explicit word alignment information which is often crucial to practical machine translation as it improves explainability.

an operation sequence model for explaina.subject: Operation Sequence Model
an operation sequence model for explaina.claim: The technique can outperform a plain text system in terms of BLEU score under the recent Transformer architecture on Japanese-English and Portuguese-English.
an operation sequence model for explaina.quote: Our technique can outperform a plain text system in terms of BLEU score under the recent Transformer architecture on Japanese-English and Portuguese-English, and is within 0.5 BLEU difference on Spanish-English.

an operation sequence model for explaina.subject: Operation Sequence Model
an operation sequence model for explaina.claim: The technique is within 0.5 BLEU difference on Spanish-English compared to a plain text system.
an operation sequence model for explaina.quote: Our technique can outperform a plain text system in terms of BLEU score under the recent Transformer architecture on Japanese-English and Portuguese-English, and is within 0.5 BLEU difference on Spanish-English.

nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.subject: NMT-Keras
nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.claim: NMT-Keras is a flexible toolkit for training deep learning models that emphasizes advanced applications of neural machine translation systems, such as interactive-predictive translation protocols and long-term adaptation via continuous learning.
nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.quote: We present NMT-Keras, a flexible toolkit for training deep learning models, which puts a particular emphasis on the development of advanced applications of neural machine translation systems, such as interactive-predictive translation protocols and long-term adaptation of the translation system via continuous learning.

nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.subject: NMT-Keras
nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.claim: NMT-Keras is based on an extended version of the Keras library and runs on Theano and TensorFlow.
nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.quote: NMT-Keras is based on an extended version of the popular Keras library, and it runs on Theano and TensorFlow.

nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.subject: NMT-Keras
nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.claim: NMT-Keras has been extended to tackle different problems, such as image and video captioning, sentence classification, and visual question answering, due to its high modularity and flexibility.
nmt keras a very flexible toolkit with a.quote: Given its high modularity and flexibility, it also has been extended to tackle different problems, such as image and video captioning, sentence classification and visual question answering.

enhancement of encoder and attention usi.subject: Method for enhancing encoder and attention using target monolingual corpora
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.claim: The paper proposes a method that enhances the encoder and attention using target monolingual corpora by generating multiple source sentences via sampling.
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.quote: In this paper, we propose a method that enhances the encoder and attention using target monolingual corpora by generating multiple source sentences via sampling.

enhancement of encoder and attention usi.subject: Method for enhancing encoder and attention using target monolingual corpora
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.claim: Using multiple source sentences achieves diversity close to that of humans.
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.quote: By using multiple source sentences, diversity close to that of humans is achieved.

enhancement of encoder and attention usi.subject: Method for enhancing encoder and attention using target monolingual corpora
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.claim: Translation quality is improved by increasing the number of synthetic source sentences for each given target sentence.
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.quote: Our experimental results show that the translation quality is improved by increasing the number of synthetic source sentences for each given target sentence, and quality close to that using a manually created parallel corpus was achieved.

enhancement of encoder and attention usi.subject: Method for enhancing encoder and attention using target monolingual corpora
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.claim: The proposed method achieves translation quality close to that using a manually created parallel corpus.
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.quote: Our experimental results show that the translation quality is improved by increasing the number of synthetic source sentences for each given target sentence, and quality close to that using a manually created parallel corpus was achieved.

enhancement of encoder and attention usi.subject: Synthetic parallel texts method
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.claim: The method of using synthetic parallel texts is unreliable for enhancing the encoder.
enhancement of encoder and attention usi.quote: The method of using synthetic parallel texts, in which target monolingual corpora are automatically translated into source sentences, is effective in improving the decoder, but is unreliable for enhancing the encoder.

iterative back translation for neural ma.subject: iterative back-translation
iterative back translation for neural ma.claim: Iterative back-translation is a method for generating increasingly better synthetic parallel data from monolingual data to train neural machine translation systems.
iterative back translation for neural ma.quote: We present iterative back-translation, a method for generating increasingly better synthetic parallel data from monolingual data to train neural machine translation systems.

iterative back translation for neural ma.subject: iterative back-translation
iterative back translation for neural ma.claim: The proposed method is very simple yet effective and highly applicable in practice.
iterative back translation for neural ma.quote: Our proposed method is very simple yet effective and highly applicable in practice.

iterative back translation for neural ma.subject: iterative back-translation
iterative back translation for neural ma.claim: The method demonstrates improvements in neural machine translation quality in both high and low resourced scenarios.
iterative back translation for neural ma.quote: We demonstrate improvements in neural machine translation quality in both high and low resourced scenarios, including the best reported BLEU scores for the WMT 2017 German↔English tasks.

iterative back translation for neural ma.subject: iterative back-translation
iterative back translation for neural ma.claim: The method achieves the best reported BLEU scores for the WMT 2017 German↔English tasks.
iterative back translation for neural ma.quote: We demonstrate improvements in neural machine translation quality in both high and low resourced scenarios, including the best reported BLEU scores for the WMT 2017 German↔English tasks.

semantically equivalent adversarial rule.subject: semantically equivalent adversaries (SEAs)
semantically equivalent adversarial rule.claim: SEAs are semantic-preserving perturbations that induce changes in the model’s predictions to automatically detect brittle behavior for individual instances.
semantically equivalent adversarial rule.quote: To automatically detect this behavior for individual instances, we present semantically equivalent adversaries (SEAs) – semantic-preserving perturbations that induce changes in the model’s predictions.

semantically equivalent adversarial rule.subject: semantically equivalent adversarial rules (SEARs)
semantically equivalent adversarial rule.claim: SEARs are simple, universal replacement rules that generalize SEAs to induce adversaries on many instances.

subword regularization improving neural.claim: The paper proposes a new subword segmentation algorithm based on a unigram language model for better subword sampling.
subword regularization improving neural.quote: In addition, for better subword sampling, we propose a new subword segmentation algorithm based on a unigram language model.

subword regularization improving neural.subject: subword regularization

seq2seq vis a visual debugging tool for.subject: Seq2seq-Vis

seq2seq vis a visual debugging tool for.subject: Neural sequence-to-sequence models

seq2seq vis a visual debugging tool for.subject: Neural sequence-to-sequence models

seq2seq vis a visual debugging tool for.quote: Neural sequence-to-sequence models have proven to be accurate and robust for many sequence prediction tasks, and have become the standard approach for automatic translation of text.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: Unsupervised NMT with Weight Sharing

unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: With this new approach, we achieve significant improvements on English-German, English-French and Chinese-to-English translation tasks.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: Existing unsupervised NMT models with one shared encoder

unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: The models proposed for unsupervised NMT often use only one shared encoder to map the pairs of sentences from different languages to a shared-latent space, which is weak in keeping the unique and internal characteristics of each language, such as the style, terminology, and sentence structure.

a call for clarity in reporting bleu sco.subject: BLEU

a call for clarity in reporting bleu sco.quote: Although people refer to “the” BLEU score, BLEU is in fact a parameterized metric whose values can vary wildly with changes to these parameters.

a call for clarity in reporting bleu sco.subject: BLEU

a call for clarity in reporting bleu sco.quote: I quantify this variation, finding differences as high as 1.8 between commonly used configurations.
