classical structured prediction losses f.claim: On the large WMT’14 English-French task, sequence-level training achieves 41.5 BLEU which is on par with the state of the art.
classical structured prediction losses f.quote: On the large WMT’14 English-French task, sequence-level training achieves 41.5 BLEU which is on par with the state of the art.

non autoregressive neural machine transl.subject: Non-Autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
non autoregressive neural machine transl.claim: The model avoids the autoregressive property and produces its outputs in parallel, allowing an order of magnitude lower latency during inference.
non autoregressive neural machine transl.quote: We introduce a model that avoids this autoregressive property and produces its outputs in parallel, allowing an order of magnitude lower latency during inference.

non autoregressive neural machine transl.subject: Non-Autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
non autoregressive neural machine transl.claim: The model achieves its performance at a cost of as little as 2.0 BLEU points relative to the autoregressive Transformer network used as a teacher through knowledge distillation, input token fertilities, and policy gradient fine-tuning.
non autoregressive neural machine transl.quote: Through knowledge distillation, the use of input token fertilities as a latent variable, and policy gradient fine-tuning, we achieve this at a cost of as little as 2.0 BLEU points relative to the autoregressive Transformer network used as a teacher.

non autoregressive neural machine transl.subject: Non-Autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
non autoregressive neural machine transl.claim: The non-autoregressive model achieves near-state-of-the-art performance of 29.8 BLEU on WMT 2016 English-Romanian by sampling fertilities in parallel at inference time.
non autoregressive neural machine transl.quote: By sampling fertilities in parallel at inference time, our non-autoregressive model achieves near-state-of-the-art performance of 29.8 BLEU on WMT 2016 English-Romanian.

non autoregressive neural machine transl.subject: Non-Autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
non autoregressive neural machine transl.claim: The approach was validated on IWSLT 2016 English-German and two WMT language pairs.
non autoregressive neural machine transl.quote: We demonstrate substantial cumulative improvements associated with each of the three aspects of our training strategy, and validate our approach on IWSLT 2016 English-German and two WMT language pairs.

neural machine translation for low resou.subject: language-independent method
neural machine translation for low resou.claim: The paper describes a language-independent method to enable machine translation between a low-resource language and a third language, such as English.
neural machine translation for low resou.quote: We describe a language-independent method to enable machine translation between a low-resource language (LRL) and a third language, e.g. English.

neural machine translation for low resou.subject: transliteration
neural machine translation for low resou.claim: The method transforms high-resource language data into data similar to the low-resource language using transliteration to take advantage of similarities between the two languages.
neural machine translation for low resou.quote: We take advantage of the similarities between the HRL and the LRL in order to transform the HRL data into data similar to the LRL using transliteration.

neural machine translation for low resou.subject: transliteration models
neural machine translation for low resou.claim: The transliteration models are trained on transliteration pairs extracted from Wikipedia article titles.
neural machine translation for low resou.quote: The transliteration models are trained on transliteration pairs extracted from Wikipedia article titles.

neural machine translation for low resou.subject: back-translation
neural machine translation for low resou.claim: The method automatically back-translates monolingual low-resource language data with models trained on transliterated high-resource language data to create a parallel corpus for final model training.
neural machine translation for low resou.quote: Then, we automatically back-translate monolingual LRL data with the models trained on the transliterated HRL data and use the resulting parallel corpus to train our final models.

neural machine translation for low resou.subject: language-independent method
neural machine translation for low resou.claim: The method achieves significant improvements in translation quality, close to the results achieved by a general purpose neural machine translation system trained on significant parallel data.
neural machine translation for low resou.quote: Our method achieves significant improvements in translation quality, close to the results that can be achieved by a general purpose neural machine translation system trained on a significant amount of parallel data.

neural machine translation for low resou.subject: language-independent method
neural machine translation for low resou.claim: The method does not rely on the existence of any parallel data for training, but attempts to bootstrap already existing resources in a related language.
neural machine translation for low resou.quote: Moreover, the method does not rely on the existence of any parallel data for training, but attempts to bootstrap already existing resources in a related language.

synthetic and natural noise both break n.subject: Character-based neural machine translation (NMT) models
synthetic and natural noise both break n.claim: Character-based NMT models are very brittle and easily falter when presented with noisy data.
synthetic and natural noise both break n.quote: Unfortunately, they are also very brittle and easily falter when presented with noisy data.

synthetic and natural noise both break n.subject: State-of-the-art NMT models
synthetic and natural noise both break n.claim: State-of-the-art models fail to translate even moderately noisy texts that humans have no trouble comprehending.
synthetic and natural noise both break n.quote: We find that state-of-the-art models fail to translate even moderately noisy texts that humans have no trouble comprehending.

synthetic and natural noise both break n.subject: Structure-invariant word representations
synthetic and natural noise both break n.claim: The paper explores structure-invariant word representations as an approach to increase model robustness.
synthetic and natural noise both break n.quote: We explore two approaches to increase model robustness: structure-invariant word representations and robust training on noisy texts.

synthetic and natural noise both break n.subject: Robust training on noisy texts
synthetic and natural noise both break n.claim: The paper explores robust training on noisy texts as an approach to increase model robustness.
synthetic and natural noise both break n.quote: We explore two approaches to increase model robustness: structure-invariant word representations and robust training on noisy texts.

synthetic and natural noise both break n.subject: Character convolutional neural network
synthetic and natural noise both break n.claim: A model based on a character convolutional neural network is able to simultaneously learn representations robust to multiple kinds of noise.
synthetic and natural noise both break n.quote: We find that a model based on a character convolutional neural network is able to simultaneously learn representations robust to multiple kinds of noise.

generating natural adversarial examples.subject: framework to generate natural and legible adversarial examples
generating natural adversarial examples.claim: The paper proposes a framework to generate natural and legible adversarial examples that lie on the data manifold by searching in the semantic space of dense and continuous data representation.
generating natural adversarial examples.quote: In this paper, we propose a framework to generate natural and legible adversarial examples that lie on the data manifold, by searching in semantic space of dense and continuous data representation, utilizing the recent advances in generative adversarial networks.

generating natural adversarial examples.subject: generated adversaries
generating natural adversarial examples.claim: Experiments show that the generated adversaries are natural, legible to humans, and useful in evaluating and analyzing black-box classifiers.
generating natural adversarial examples.quote: We include experiments to show that the generated adversaries are natural, legible to humans, and useful in evaluating and analyzing black-box classifiers.

generating natural adversarial examples.subject: malicious perturbations
generating natural adversarial examples.claim: Existing malicious perturbations are often unnatural, not semantically meaningful, and not applicable to complicated domains such as language.
generating natural adversarial examples.quote: However, these malicious perturbations are often unnatural, not semantically meaningful, and not applicable to complicated domains such as language.

unsupervised machine translation using m.subject: Unsupervised Machine Translation Model
unsupervised machine translation using m.claim: The proposed model takes sentences from monolingual corpora in two different languages and maps them into the same latent space.
unsupervised machine translation using m.quote: We propose a model that takes sentences from monolingual corpora in two different languages and maps them into the same latent space.

unsupervised machine translation using m.subject: Unsupervised Machine Translation Model
unsupervised machine translation using m.claim: By learning to reconstruct in both languages from this shared feature space, the model effectively learns to translate without using any labeled data.
unsupervised machine translation using m.quote: By learning to reconstruct in both languages from this shared feature space, the model effectively learns to translate without using any labeled data.

unsupervised machine translation using m.subject: Unsupervised Machine Translation Model
unsupervised machine translation using m.claim: The model reports BLEU scores of 32.8 and 15.1 on the Multi30k and WMT English-French datasets, respectively, without using any parallel sentences at training time.
unsupervised machine translation using m.quote: We demonstrate our model on two widely used datasets and two language pairs, reporting BLEU scores of 32.8 and 15.1 on the Multi30k and WMT English-French datasets, without using even a single parallel sentence at training time.

unsupervised machine translation using m.subject: Existing low-resource machine translation approaches
unsupervised machine translation using m.claim: Previous attempts to extend deep learning successes to low-resource language pairs have required tens of thousands of parallel sentences.
unsupervised machine translation using m.quote: There have been numerous attempts to extend these successes to low-resource language pairs, yet requiring tens of thousands of parallel sentences.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: Unsupervised NMT system
unsupervised neural machine translation.claim: The proposed method trains an NMT system in a completely unsupervised manner relying on nothing but monolingual corpora.
unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: In this work, we completely remove the need of parallel data and propose a novel method to train an NMT system in a completely unsupervised manner, relying on nothing but monolingual corpora.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: Unsupervised NMT system
unsupervised neural machine translation.claim: The model consists of a slightly modified attentional encoder-decoder model trained on monolingual corpora alone using a combination of denoising and backtranslation.
unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: Our model builds upon the recent work on unsupervised embedding mappings, and consists of a slightly modified attentional encoder-decoder model that can be trained on monolingual corpora alone using a combination of denoising and backtranslation.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: Unsupervised NMT system
unsupervised neural machine translation.claim: The system obtains 15.56 and 10.21 BLEU points in WMT 2014 French-to-English and German-to-English translation.
unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: Despite the simplicity of the approach, our system obtains 15.56 and 10.21 BLEU points in WMT 2014 French-to-English and German-to-English translation.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: Unsupervised NMT system
unsupervised neural machine translation.claim: The model attains 21.81 and 15.24 points when combined with 100,000 parallel sentences for French-to-English and German-to-English translation respectively.
unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: The model can also profit from small parallel corpora, and attains 21.81 and 15.24 points when combined with 100,000 parallel sentences, respectively.

unsupervised neural machine translation.subject: neural machine translation
unsupervised neural machine translation.claim: The lack of large parallel corpora poses a major practical problem for many language pairs.
unsupervised neural machine translation.quote: In spite of the recent success of neural machine translation (NMT) in standard benchmarks, the lack of large parallel corpora poses a major practical problem for many language pairs.

word translation without parallel data.subject: unsupervised alignment of monolingual word embedding spaces
word translation without parallel data.claim: The authors propose a method to build a bilingual dictionary between two languages by aligning monolingual word embedding spaces in an unsupervised way without using any parallel corpora.
word translation without parallel data.quote: In this work, we show that we can build a bilingual dictionary between two languages without using any parallel corpora, by aligning monolingual word embedding spaces in an unsupervised way.

word translation without parallel data.subject: unsupervised alignment of monolingual word embedding spaces
word translation without parallel data.claim: The proposed model outperforms existing supervised methods on cross-lingual tasks for some language pairs without using any character information.
word translation without parallel data.quote: Without using any character information, our model even outperforms existing supervised methods on cross-lingual tasks for some language pairs.

word translation without parallel data.subject: unsupervised alignment of monolingual word embedding spaces
word translation without parallel data.claim: The method works very well for distant language pairs, such as English-Russian or English-Chinese.
word translation without parallel data.quote: Our experiments demonstrate that our method works very well also for distant language pairs, like English-Russian or English-Chinese.

word translation without parallel data.subject: character-level information methods
word translation without parallel data.claim: Existing methods that alleviate the need for parallel data supervision using character-level information are limited to pairs of languages sharing a common alphabet.
word translation without parallel data.quote: While these methods showed encouraging results, they are not on par with their supervised counterparts and are limited to pairs of languages sharing a common alphabet.

on integrating a language model into neu.subject: neural machine translation with neural language model score combination
on integrating a language model into neu.claim: The paper explores a strategy of combining scores from a neural language model trained only on target monolingual data with a neural machine translation model.
on integrating a language model into neu.quote: We observe improvements by both combining scores from neural language model trained only on target monolingual data with neural machine translation model and fusing hidden-states of these two models.

on integrating a language model into neu.subject: neural machine translation with hidden-state fusion
on integrating a language model into neu.claim: The paper explores a strategy of fusing the hidden-states of a neural language model and a neural machine translation model.
on integrating a language model into neu.quote: We observe improvements by both combining scores from neural language model trained only on target monolingual data with neural machine translation model and fusing hidden-states of these two models.

on integrating a language model into neu.subject: neural machine translation with monolingual data integration
on integrating a language model into neu.claim: The proposed methods obtain up to 2 BLEU improvement over hierarchical and phrase-based baselines on the low-resource Turkish-English language pair.
on integrating a language model into neu.quote: We obtain up to 2 BLEU improvement over hierarchical and phrase-based baseline on low-resource language pair, Turkish English.

on integrating a language model into neu.subject: neural machine translation with monolingual data integration
on integrating a language model into neu.claim: The methods extend to high-resource languages, obtaining 0.39 and 0.47 BLEU improvements over neural machine translation baselines on Czech-English and German-English tasks, respectively.
on integrating a language model into neu.quote: Our method was initially motivated towards tasks with less parallel data, but we also show that it extends to high resource languages such as Cs En and De En translation tasks, where we obtain 0.39 and 0.47 BLEU improvements over the neural machine translation baselines, respectively.

the university of edinburgh s neural mt.subject: Nematus
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.claim: The systems are neural machine translation systems trained with Nematus, an attentional encoder-decoder.
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.quote: Our systems are neural machine translation systems trained with Nematus, an attentional encoder-decoder.

the university of edinburgh s neural mt.subject: BPE-based models
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.claim: The authors build BPE-based models using parallel and back-translated monolingual training data.
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.quote: We follow our setup from last year and build BPE-based models with parallel and back-translated monolingual training data.

the university of edinburgh s neural mt.subject: Deep architectures
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.claim: The use of deep architectures is a novelty in this year's systems.
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.quote: Novelties this year include the use of deep architectures, layer normalization, and more compact models due to weight tying and improvements in BPE segmentations.

the university of edinburgh s neural mt.subject: Layer normalization
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.claim: The use of layer normalization is a novelty in this year's systems.
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.quote: Novelties this year include the use of deep architectures, layer normalization, and more compact models due to weight tying and improvements in BPE segmentations.

the university of edinburgh s neural mt.subject: Weight tying
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.claim: Weight tying is used to create more compact models.
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.quote: Novelties this year include the use of deep architectures, layer normalization, and more compact models due to weight tying and improvements in BPE segmentations.

the university of edinburgh s neural mt.subject: Ablative experiments
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.claim: The authors perform extensive ablative experiments to report on the effectiveness of layer normalization, deep architectures, and different ensembling techniques.
the university of edinburgh s neural mt.quote: We perform extensive ablative experiments, reporting on the effectivenes of layer normalization, deep architectures, and different ensembling techniques.

prior knowledge integration for neural m.subject: posterior regularization
prior knowledge integration for neural m.claim: The authors propose to use posterior regularization to provide a general framework for integrating prior knowledge into neural machine translation.
prior knowledge integration for neural m.quote: In this work, we propose to use posterior regularization to provide a general framework for integrating prior knowledge into neural machine translation.

prior knowledge integration for neural m.subject: log-linear model
prior knowledge integration for neural m.claim: Prior knowledge sources are represented as features in a log-linear model, which guides the learning processing of the neural translation model.
prior knowledge integration for neural m.quote: We represent prior knowledge sources as features in a log-linear model, which guides the learning processing of the neural translation model.

prior knowledge integration for neural m.subject: posterior regularization
prior knowledge integration for neural m.claim: Experiments on the Chinese-English dataset show that the approach leads to significant improvements.
prior knowledge integration for neural m.quote: Experiments on Chinese-English dataset show that our approach leads to significant improvements.

prior knowledge integration for neural m.subject: neural machine translation
prior knowledge integration for neural m.claim: Integrating multiple overlapping, arbitrary prior knowledge sources remains a challenge for neural machine translation.
prior knowledge integration for neural m.quote: Although neural machine translation has made significant progress recently, how to integrate multiple overlapping, arbitrary prior knowledge sources remains a challenge.

learning bilingual word embeddings with.subject: self-learning approach
learning bilingual word embeddings with.claim: The proposed self-learning approach can be combined with any dictionary-based mapping technique to reduce the need for bilingual resources.
learning bilingual word embeddings with.quote: In this work, we further reduce the need of bilingual resources using a very simple self-learning approach that can be combined with any dictionary-based mapping technique.

learning bilingual word embeddings with.subject: self-learning approach
learning bilingual word embeddings with.claim: The method exploits the structural similarity of embedding spaces to work with minimal bilingual evidence.
learning bilingual word embeddings with.quote: Our method exploits the structural similarity of embedding spaces, and works with as little bilingual evidence as a 25 word dictionary or even an automatically generated list of numerals, obtaining results comparable to those of systems that use richer resources.

learning bilingual word embeddings with.subject: self-learning approach
learning bilingual word embeddings with.claim: The method obtains results comparable to systems that use richer resources when using as little as a 25-word dictionary or an automatically generated list of numerals.
learning bilingual word embeddings with.quote: Our method exploits the structural similarity of embedding spaces, and works with as little bilingual evidence as a 25 word dictionary or even an automatically generated list of numerals, obtaining results comparable to those of systems that use richer resources.

learning bilingual word embeddings with.subject: large parallel corpora
learning bilingual word embeddings with.claim: Large parallel corpora are difficult to obtain for most language pairs.
learning bilingual word embeddings with.quote: Most methods to learn bilingual word embeddings rely on large parallel corpora, which is difficult to obtain for most language pairs.

sequence to dependency neural machine tr.subject: SD-NMT
sequence to dependency neural machine tr.claim: The paper proposes a novel Sequence-to-Dependency Neural Machine Translation (SD-NMT) method where the target word sequence and its dependency structure are jointly constructed and modeled.
sequence to dependency neural machine tr.quote: in this paper we propose a novel Sequence-to-Dependency Neural Machine Translation (SD-NMT) method, in which the target word sequence and its corresponding dependency structure are jointly constructed and modeled, and this structure is used as context to facilitate word generations.

sequence to dependency neural machine tr.subject: SD-NMT
sequence to dependency neural machine tr.claim: The proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on Chinese-English and Japanese-English translation tasks.
sequence to dependency neural machine tr.quote: Experimental results show that the proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on Chinese-English and Japanese-English translation tasks.

sequence to dependency neural machine tr.subject: typical NMT model
sequence to dependency neural machine tr.claim: A typical Neural Machine Translation model generates translations from left to right as a linear sequence without explicitly concerning latent syntactic structures of the target sentences.
sequence to dependency neural machine tr.quote: Nowadays a typical Neural Machine Translation (NMT) model generates translations from left to right as a linear sequence, during which latent syntactic structures of the target sentences are not explicitly concerned.

adversarial training for unsupervised bi.subject: Adversarial Training for Unsupervised Bilingual Lexicon Induction
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.claim: The problem of connecting separate monolingual word embeddings is formulated as a natural adversarial game to establish cross-lingual connection without supervision.
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.quote: We achieve this end by formulating the problem as a natural adversarial game, and investigating techniques that are crucial to successful training.

adversarial training for unsupervised bi.subject: Adversarial Training for Unsupervised Bilingual Lexicon Induction
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.claim: Cross-lingual connection between separate monolingual word embeddings can be established without any form of supervision.
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.quote: In this work, we show that such cross-lingual connection can actually be established without any form of supervision.

adversarial training for unsupervised bi.subject: Adversarial Training for Unsupervised Bilingual Lexicon Induction
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.claim: The method demonstrates encouraging performance on the unsupervised bilingual lexicon induction task without using any cross-lingual clues.
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.quote: Even though this task appears intrinsically cross-lingual, we are able to demonstrate encouraging performance without any cross-lingual clues.

adversarial training for unsupervised bi.subject: previous endeavors to connect separate monolingual word embeddings
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.claim: Previous methods for connecting separate monolingual word embeddings typically require cross-lingual signals as supervision, such as parallel corpora or seed lexicons.
adversarial training for unsupervised bi.quote: However, previous endeavors to connect separate monolingual word embeddings typically require cross-lingual signals as supervision, either in the form of parallel corpus or seed lexicon.

visualizing and understanding neural mac.subject: neural machine translation
visualizing and understanding neural mac.claim: It is hard to interpret the internal workings of neural machine translation due to the continuous representations and non-linearity of neural networks.
visualizing and understanding neural mac.quote: While neural machine translation (NMT) has made remarkable progress in recent years, it is hard to interpret its internal workings due to the continuous representations and non-linearity of neural networks.

visualizing and understanding neural mac.subject: layer-wise relevance propagation
visualizing and understanding neural mac.claim: The authors propose to use layer-wise relevance propagation to compute the contribution of each contextual word to arbitrary hidden states in the attention-based encoder-decoder framework.
visualizing and understanding neural mac.quote: In this work, we propose to use layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) to compute the contribution of each contextual word to arbitrary hidden states in the attention-based encoder-decoder framework.

visualizing and understanding neural mac.subject: layer-wise relevance propagation
visualizing and understanding neural mac.claim: Visualization with layer-wise relevance propagation helps to interpret the internal workings of neural machine translation and analyze translation errors.
visualizing and understanding neural mac.quote: We show that visualization with LRP helps to interpret the internal workings of NMT and analyze translation errors.

attention is all you need.subject: Transformer
attention is all you need.claim: The Transformer is a new simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms that dispenses with recurrence and convolutions entirely.
attention is all you need.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

attention is all you need.subject: Transformer
attention is all you need.claim: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show the Transformer models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.
attention is all you need.quote: Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.

attention is all you need.subject: Transformer
attention is all you need.claim: The model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over existing best results by over 2 BLEU.
attention is all you need.quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles by over 2 BLEU.

attention is all you need.subject: Transformer
attention is all you need.claim: On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, the model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs.
attention is all you need.quote: On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs, a small fraction of the training costs of the best models from the literature.

attention is all you need.subject: Transformer
attention is all you need.claim: The Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.
attention is all you need.quote: We show that the Transformer generalizes well to other tasks by applying it successfully to English constituency parsing both with large and limited training data.

depthwise separable convolutions for neu.subject: SliceNet
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.claim: SliceNet is a new architecture inspired by Xception and ByteNet that enables a significant reduction of the parameter count and amount of computation needed to obtain results like ByteNet.
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.quote: We introduce a new architecture inspired by Xception and ByteNet, called SliceNet, which enables a significant reduction of the parameter count and amount of computation needed to obtain results like ByteNet, and, with a similar parameter count, achieves new state-of-the-art results.

depthwise separable convolutions for neu.subject: SliceNet
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.claim: With a similar parameter count to ByteNet, SliceNet achieves new state-of-the-art results in neural machine translation.
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.quote: We introduce a new architecture inspired by Xception and ByteNet, called SliceNet, which enables a significant reduction of the parameter count and amount of computation needed to obtain results like ByteNet, and, with a similar parameter count, achieves new state-of-the-art results.

depthwise separable convolutions for neu.subject: depthwise separable convolutions
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.claim: Thanks to depthwise separability, it is possible to increase the length of convolution windows, removing the need for filter dilation.
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.quote: we observe that thanks to depthwise separability, we can increase the length of convolution windows, removing the need for filter dilation.

depthwise separable convolutions for neu.subject: super-separable convolution
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.claim: A new "super-separable" convolution operation is introduced that further reduces the number of parameters and computational cost for obtaining state-of-the-art results.
depthwise separable convolutions for neu.quote: We also introduce a new "super-separable" convolution operation that further reduces the number of parameters and computational cost for obtaining state-of-the-art results.

convolutional sequence to sequence learn.subject: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.claim: The paper introduces an architecture based entirely on convolutional neural networks for sequence to sequence learning.
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.quote: We introduce an architecture based entirely on convolutional neural networks.

convolutional sequence to sequence learn.subject: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.claim: Compared to recurrent models, computations over all elements can be fully parallelized during training and optimization is easier since the number of non-linearities is fixed and independent of the input length.
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.quote: Compared to recurrent models, computations over all elements can be fully parallelized during training and optimization is easier since the number of non-linearities is fixed and independent of the input length.

convolutional sequence to sequence learn.subject: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.claim: The architecture uses gated linear units to ease gradient propagation and equips each decoder layer with a separate attention module.
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.quote: Our use of gated linear units eases gradient propagation and we equip each decoder layer with a separate attention module.

convolutional sequence to sequence learn.subject: Convolutional Sequence to Sequence Learning
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.claim: The proposed architecture outperforms the accuracy of the deep LSTM setup of Wu et al. (2016) on WMT'14 English-German and WMT'14 English-French translation at an order of magnitude faster speed on both GPU and CPU.
convolutional sequence to sequence learn.quote: We outperform the accuracy of the deep LSTM setup of Wu et al. (2016) on both WMT'14 English-German and WMT'14 English-French translation at an order of magnitude faster speed, both on GPU and CPU.
mentions: deep LSTM setup of Wu et al. (2016)

towards string to tree neural machine tr.subject: syntax-aware NMT system
towards string to tree neural machine tr.claim: The paper presents a simple method to incorporate syntactic information about the target language in a neural machine translation system by translating into linearized, lexicalized constituency trees.
towards string to tree neural machine tr.quote: We present a simple method to incorporate syntactic information about the target language in a neural machine translation system by translating into linearized, lexicalized constituency trees.

towards string to tree neural machine tr.subject: syntax-aware NMT system
towards string to tree neural machine tr.claim: An experiment on the WMT16 German-English news translation task resulted in an improved BLEU score when compared to a syntax-agnostic NMT baseline trained on the same dataset.
towards string to tree neural machine tr.quote: An experiment on the WMT16 German-English news translation task resulted in an improved BLEU score when compared to a syntax-agnostic NMT baseline trained on the same dataset.

towards string to tree neural machine tr.subject: syntax-aware NMT system
towards string to tree neural machine tr.claim: An analysis of the translations from the syntax-aware system shows that it performs more reordering during translation in comparison to the baseline.
towards string to tree neural machine tr.quote: An analysis of the translations from the syntax-aware system shows that it performs more reordering during translation in comparison to the baseline.

towards string to tree neural machine tr.subject: syntax-aware NMT system
towards string to tree neural machine tr.claim: A small-scale human evaluation also showed an advantage to the syntax-aware system.
towards string to tree neural machine tr.quote: A small-scale human evaluation also showed an advantage to the syntax-aware system.

graph convolutional encoders for syntax.subject: Graph Convolutional Encoders
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.claim: The paper presents an approach to incorporating syntactic structure into neural attention-based encoder-decoder models for machine translation using graph-convolutional networks.
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.quote: We present a simple and effective approach to incorporating syntactic structure into neural attention-based encoder-decoder models for machine translation. We rely on graph-convolutional networks (GCNs), a recent class of neural networks developed for modeling graph-structured data.

graph convolutional encoders for syntax.subject: Graph Convolutional Encoders
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.claim: The GCNs use predicted syntactic dependency trees of source sentences to produce word representations that are sensitive to their syntactic neighborhoods.
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.quote: Our GCNs use predicted syntactic dependency trees of source sentences to produce representations of words (i.e. hidden states of the encoder) that are sensitive to their syntactic neighborhoods.

graph convolutional encoders for syntax.subject: Graph Convolutional Encoders
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.claim: GCNs can be easily incorporated as layers into standard encoders, such as on top of bidirectional RNNs or convolutional neural networks.
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.quote: GCNs take word representations as input and produce word representations as output, so they can easily be incorporated as layers into standard encoders (e.g., on top of bidirectional RNNs or convolutional neural networks).

graph convolutional encoders for syntax.subject: Graph Convolutional Encoders
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.claim: Experiments on English-German and English-Czech translation show substantial improvements over syntax-agnostic versions in all considered setups.
graph convolutional encoders for syntax.quote: We evaluate their effectiveness with English-German and English-Czech translation experiments for different types of encoders and observe substantial improvements over their syntax-agnostic versions in all the considered setups.

learning to parse and translate improves.subject: NMT+RNNG

learning to parse and translate improves.quote: In this paper, we propose a hybrid model, called NMT+RNNG, that learns to parse and translate by combining the recurrent neural network grammar into the attention-based neural machine translation.

learning to parse and translate improves.subject: NMT+RNNG
learning to parse and translate improves.claim: The approach encourages the neural machine translation model to incorporate linguistic prior during training, and lets it translate on its own afterward.
learning to parse and translate improves.quote: Our approach encourages the neural machine translation model to incorporate linguistic prior during training, and lets it translate on its own afterward.

learning to parse and translate improves.subject: NMT+RNNG
learning to parse and translate improves.claim: Extensive experiments with four language pairs show the effectiveness of the proposed NMT+RNNG.
learning to parse and translate improves.quote: Extensive experiments with four language pairs show the effectiveness of the proposed NMT+RNNG.

learning to parse and translate improves.subject: previous work
learning to parse and translate improves.claim: Much of the previous work was further constrained to considering linguistic prior on the source side.
learning to parse and translate improves.quote: Much of the previous work was further constrained to considering linguistic prior on the source side.

towards decoding as continuous optimisat.subject: continuous optimisation decoding approach
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.claim: The paper proposes a novel decoding approach for neural machine translation based on continuous optimisation.
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.quote: We propose a novel decoding approach for neural machine translation (NMT) based on continuous optimisation.

towards decoding as continuous optimisat.subject: continuous optimisation decoding approach
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.claim: The method reformulates decoding into a continuous problem to allow optimization to use efficient gradient-based techniques.
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.quote: We reformulate decoding, a discrete optimization problem, into a continuous problem, such that optimization can make use of efficient gradient-based techniques.

towards decoding as continuous optimisat.subject: continuous optimisation decoding approach
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.claim: The decoding framework allows for more accurate decoding for standard neural machine translation models.
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.quote: Our powerful decoding framework allows for more accurate decoding for standard neural machine translation models, as well as enabling decoding in intractable models such as intersection of several different NMT models.

towards decoding as continuous optimisat.subject: continuous optimisation decoding approach
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.claim: The framework enables decoding in intractable models such as the intersection of several different NMT models.
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.quote: Our powerful decoding framework allows for more accurate decoding for standard neural machine translation models, as well as enabling decoding in intractable models such as intersection of several different NMT models.

towards decoding as continuous optimisat.subject: continuous optimisation decoding approach
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.claim: Empirical results show the framework is effective and leads to substantial improvements in translations, especially where greedy search and beam search are not feasible.
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.quote: Our empirical results show that our decoding framework is effective, and can leads to substantial improvements in translations, especially in situations where greedy search and beam search are not feasible.

towards decoding as continuous optimisat.subject: continuous optimisation decoding approach
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.claim: The technique is highly competitive with, and complementary to, reranking.
towards decoding as continuous optimisat.quote: Finally, we show how the technique is highly competitive with, and complementary to, reranking.

dual learning for machine translation.subject: dual-learning mechanism
dual learning for machine translation.claim: The dual-learning mechanism enables an NMT system to automatically learn from unlabeled data through a dual-learning game.
dual learning for machine translation.quote: To tackle this training data bottleneck, we develop a dual-learning mechanism, which can enable an NMT system to automatically learn from unlabeled data through a dual-learning game.

dual learning for machine translation.subject: dual-learning mechanism
dual learning for machine translation.claim: The primal and dual tasks can form a closed loop and generate informative feedback signals to train translation models without human labelers.
dual learning for machine translation.quote: the primal and dual tasks can form a closed loop, and generate informative feedback signals to train the translation models, even if without the involvement of a human labeler.

dual learning for machine translation.subject: dual-NMT
dual learning for machine translation.claim: Dual-NMT uses two agents representing primal and dual task models that teach each other through a reinforcement learning process.
dual learning for machine translation.quote: In the dual-learning mechanism, we use one agent to represent the model for the primal task and the other agent to represent the model for the dual task, then ask them to teach each other through a reinforcement learning process.

dual learning for machine translation.subject: dual-NMT
dual learning for machine translation.claim: Dual-NMT achieves comparable accuracy to NMT trained on full bilingual data for French-to-English translation when using monolingual data and 10% bilingual data for warm start.
dual learning for machine translation.quote: especially, by learning from monolingual data (with 10% bilingual data for warm start), it achieves a comparable accuracy to NMT trained from the full bilingual data for the French-to-English translation task.

exploiting source side monolingual data.subject: self-learning algorithm for synthetic parallel data
exploiting source side monolingual data.claim: The first approach employs the self-learning algorithm to generate the synthetic large-scale parallel data for NMT training.
exploiting source side monolingual data.quote: The first approach employs the self-learning algorithm to generate the synthetic large-scale parallel data for NMT training.

exploiting source side monolingual data.subject: multi-task learning framework with two NMTs
exploiting source side monolingual data.claim: The second approach applies the multi-task learning framework using two NMTs to predict the translation and the reordered source-side monolingual sentences simultaneously.
exploiting source side monolingual data.quote: The second approach applies the multi-task learning framework using two NMTs to predict the translation and the reordered source-side monolingual sentences simultaneously.

exploiting source side monolingual data.subject: proposed methods
exploiting source side monolingual data.claim: The proposed methods obtain significant improvements over the strong attention-based NMT.
exploiting source side monolingual data.quote: The extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods obtain significant improvements over the strong attention-based NMT.

exploiting source side monolingual data.subject: source-side monolingual data usage
exploiting source side monolingual data.claim: The source-side monolingual data is not fully explored although it should be useful to strengthen the encoder model of NMT.
exploiting source side monolingual data.quote: However, the source-side monolingual data is not fully explored although it should be useful to strengthen the encoder model of NMT, especially when the parallel corpus is far from sufﬁcient.

neural machine translation in linear tim.subject: ByteNet
neural machine translation in linear tim.claim: The ByteNet is a one-dimensional convolutional neural network composed of an encoder and a decoder connected by stacking the decoder on top of the encoder.
neural machine translation in linear tim.quote: The ByteNet is a one-dimensional convolutional neural network that is composed of two parts, one to encode the source sequence and the other to decode the target sequence. The two network parts are connected by stacking the decoder on top of the encoder and preserving the temporal resolution of the sequences.

neural machine translation in linear tim.subject: ByteNet
neural machine translation in linear tim.claim: The ByteNet uses dilation in the convolutional layers to increase its receptive field.
neural machine translation in linear tim.quote: The ByteNet uses dilation in the convolutional layers to increase its receptive field.

neural machine translation in linear tim.subject: ByteNet
neural machine translation in linear tim.claim: The resulting network runs in time that is linear in the length of the sequences and sidesteps the need for excessive memorization.
neural machine translation in linear tim.quote: The resulting network has two core properties: it runs in time that is linear in the length of the sequences and it sidesteps the need for excessive memorization.

neural machine translation in linear tim.subject: ByteNet decoder
neural machine translation in linear tim.claim: The ByteNet decoder attains state-of-the-art performance on character-level language modelling and outperforms the previous best results obtained with recurrent networks.
neural machine translation in linear tim.quote: The ByteNet decoder attains state-of-the-art performance on character-level language modelling and outperforms the previous best results obtained with recurrent networks.

neural machine translation in linear tim.subject: ByteNet
neural machine translation in linear tim.claim: The ByteNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on character-to-character machine translation on the English-to-German WMT translation task, surpassing comparable neural translation models based on recurrent networks with attentional pooling.
neural machine translation in linear tim.quote: The ByteNet also achieves state-of-the-art performance on character-to-character machine translation on the English-to-German WMT translation task, surpassing comparable neural translation models that are based on recurrent networks with attentional pooling and run in quadratic time.

neural machine translation in linear tim.subject: ByteNet
neural machine translation in linear tim.claim: The latent alignment structure contained in the representations reflects the expected alignment between the tokens.
neural machine translation in linear tim.quote: We find that the latent alignment structure contained in the representations reflects the expected alignment between the tokens.

fully character level neural machine tra.subject: character-level convolutional network with max-pooling
fully character level neural machine tra.claim: The model employs a character-level convolutional network with max-pooling at the encoder to reduce the length of source representation.
fully character level neural machine tra.quote: We employ a character-level convolutional network with max-pooling at the encoder to reduce the length of source representation, allowing the model to be trained at a speed comparable to subword-level models while capturing local regularities.

fully character level neural machine tra.subject: character-to-character model
fully character level neural machine tra.claim: The character-to-character model outperforms a recently proposed baseline with a subword-level encoder on WMT’15 DE-EN and CS-EN.
fully character level neural machine tra.quote: Our character-to-character model outperforms a recently proposed baseline with a subword-level encoder on WMT’15 DE-EN and CS-EN, and gives comparable performance on FI-EN and RU-EN.

fully character level neural machine tra.subject: character-to-character model
fully character level neural machine tra.claim: The character-to-character model gives comparable performance on FI-EN and RU-EN compared to the subword-level baseline.
fully character level neural machine tra.quote: Our character-to-character model outperforms a recently proposed baseline with a subword-level encoder on WMT’15 DE-EN and CS-EN, and gives comparable performance on FI-EN and RU-EN.

fully character level neural machine tra.subject: multilingual character-level encoder
fully character level neural machine tra.claim: It is possible to share a single character-level encoder across multiple languages by training a model on a many-to-one translation task.
fully character level neural machine tra.quote: We then demonstrate that it is possible to share a single character-level encoder across multiple languages by training a model on a many-to-one translation task.

fully character level neural machine tra.subject: multilingual character-level encoder
fully character level neural machine tra.claim: In the multilingual setting, the character-level encoder significantly outperforms the subword-level encoder on all the language pairs.
fully character level neural machine tra.quote: In this multilingual setting, the character-level encoder significantly outperforms the subword-level encoder on all the language pairs.

fully character level neural machine tra.subject: multilingual character-level translation
fully character level neural machine tra.claim: On CS-EN, FI-EN and RU-EN, the quality of the multilingual character-level translation surpasses the models specifically trained on that language pair alone in terms of BLEU score and human judgment.
fully character level neural machine tra.quote: We observe that on CS-EN, FI-EN and RU-EN, the quality of the multilingual character-level translation even surpasses the models specifically trained on that language pair alone, both in terms of the BLEU score and human judgment.

is neural machine translation ready for.subject: AmuNMT
is neural machine translation ready for.claim: AmuNMT is an efficient neural machine translation decoder introduced to investigate aspects of translation speed.
is neural machine translation ready for.quote: In the second part of the paper we investigate aspects of translation speed, introducing AmuNMT, our efficient neural machine translation decoder.

is neural machine translation ready for.subject: neural machine translation
is neural machine translation ready for.claim: Current neural machine translation could already be used for in-production systems when comparing words-per-second ratios.
is neural machine translation ready for.quote: We demonstrate that current neural machine translation could already be used for in-production systems when comparing words-persecond ratios.

is neural machine translation ready for.subject: United Nations Parallel Corpus v1.0
is neural machine translation ready for.claim: Experiments are performed for the recently published United Nations Parallel Corpus v1.0 and its large six-way sentence-aligned subcorpus.
is neural machine translation ready for.quote: Experiments are performed for the recently published United Nations Parallel Corpus v1.0 and its large six-way sentence-aligned subcorpus.

is neural machine translation ready for.subject: phrase-based SMT
is neural machine translation ready for.claim: The paper provides the largest published comparison of translation quality for phrase-based SMT and neural machine translation across 30 translation directions.
is neural machine translation ready for.quote: In this paper we provide the largest published comparison of translation quality for phrase-based SMT and neural machine translation across 30 translation directions.

is neural machine translation ready for.subject: hierarchical phrase-based MT
is neural machine translation ready for.claim: Hierarchical phrase-based MT is included in the comparison for ten translation directions.
is neural machine translation ready for.quote: For ten directions we also include hierarchical phrase-based MT.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: GNMT
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: GNMT consists of a deep LSTM network with 8 encoder and 8 decoder layers using attention and residual connections.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: Our model consists of a deep LSTM network with 8 encoder and 8 decoder layers using attention and residual connections.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: GNMT
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: The attention mechanism connects the bottom layer of the decoder to the top layer of the encoder to improve parallelism and decrease training time.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: To improve parallelism and therefore decrease training time, our attention mechanism connects the bottom layer of the decoder to the top layer of the encoder.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: GNMT
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: Low-precision arithmetic is employed during inference computations to accelerate the final translation speed.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: To accelerate the final translation speed, we employ low-precision arithmetic during inference computations.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: wordpieces
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: Words are divided into a limited set of common sub-word units called wordpieces to improve handling of rare words.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: To improve handling of rare words, we divide words into a limited set of common sub-word units ("wordpieces") for both input and output.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: beam search
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: The beam search technique employs a length-normalization procedure and uses a coverage penalty to encourage generation of an output sentence that covers all source words.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: Our beam search technique employs a length-normalization procedure and uses a coverage penalty, which encourages generation of an output sentence that is most likely to cover all the words in the source sentence.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: GNMT
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: GNMT reduces translation errors by an average of 60% compared to Google's phrase-based production system in a human side-by-side evaluation.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: Using a human side-by-side evaluation on a set of isolated simple sentences, it reduces translation errors by an average of 60% compared to Google's phrase-based production system.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: NMT
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: NMT systems are known to be computationally expensive both in training and in translation inference.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: Unfortunately, NMT systems are known to be computationally expensive both in training and in translation inference.

google s neural machine translation syst.subject: NMT
google s neural machine translation syst.claim: Most NMT systems have difficulty with rare words.
google s neural machine translation syst.quote: Also, most NMT systems have difficulty with rare words.

layer normalization.subject: layer normalization
layer normalization.claim: Layer normalization computes the mean and variance used for normalization from all of the summed inputs to the neurons in a layer on a single training case.
layer normalization.quote: In this paper, we transpose batch normalization into layer normalization by computing the mean and variance used for normalization from all of the summed inputs to the neurons in a layer on a single training case.

layer normalization.subject: layer normalization
layer normalization.claim: Layer normalization performs exactly the same computation at training and test times.
layer normalization.quote: Unlike batch normalization, layer normalization performs exactly the same computation at training and test times.

layer normalization.subject: layer normalization
layer normalization.claim: It is straightforward to apply layer normalization to recurrent neural networks by computing the normalization statistics separately at each time step.
layer normalization.quote: It is also straightforward to apply to recurrent neural networks by computing the normalization statistics separately at each time step.

layer normalization.subject: layer normalization
layer normalization.claim: Layer normalization is very effective at stabilizing the hidden state dynamics in recurrent networks.
layer normalization.quote: Layer normalization is very effective at stabilizing the hidden state dynamics in recurrent networks.

layer normalization.subject: layer normalization
layer normalization.claim: Layer normalization can substantially reduce the training time compared with previously published techniques.
layer normalization.quote: Empirically, we show that layer normalization can substantially reduce the training time compared with previously published techniques.

layer normalization.subject: batch normalization
layer normalization.claim: The effect of batch normalization is dependent on the mini-batch size.
layer normalization.quote: However, the effect of batch normalization is dependent on the mini-batch size and it is not obvious how to apply it to recurrent neural networks.

sequence level knowledge distillation.subject: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation
sequence level knowledge distillation.claim: The paper introduces two novel sequence-level versions of knowledge distillation that further improve performance in NMT.
sequence level knowledge distillation.quote: We demonstrate that standard knowledge distillation applied to word-level prediction can be effective for NMT, and also introduce two novel sequence-level versions of knowledge distillation that further improve performance, and somewhat surprisingly, seem to eliminate the need for beam search (even when applied on the original teacher model).

sequence level knowledge distillation.subject: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation
sequence level knowledge distillation.claim: The best student model runs 10 times faster than its state-of-the-art teacher with little loss in performance.
sequence level knowledge distillation.quote: Our best student model runs 10 times faster than its state-of-the-art teacher with little loss in performance.

sequence level knowledge distillation.subject: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation
sequence level knowledge distillation.claim: The student model is significantly better than a baseline model trained without knowledge distillation by 4.2 BLEU with greedy decoding and 1.7 BLEU with beam search.
sequence level knowledge distillation.quote: It is also significantly better than a baseline model trained without knowledge distillation: by 4.2/1.7 BLEU with greedy decoding/beam search.

sequence level knowledge distillation.subject: Weight Pruning
sequence level knowledge distillation.claim: Applying weight pruning on top of knowledge distillation results in a student model that has 13 times fewer parameters than the original teacher model, with a decrease of 0.4 BLEU.
sequence level knowledge distillation.quote: Applying weight pruning on top of knowledge distillation results in a student model that has 13 times fewer parameters than the original teacher model, with a decrease of 0.4 BLEU.

sequence level knowledge distillation.subject: Sequence-Level Knowledge Distillation
sequence level knowledge distillation.claim: Sequence-level knowledge distillation seems to eliminate the need for beam search, even when applied on the original teacher model.
sequence level knowledge distillation.quote: We demonstrate that standard knowledge distillation applied to word-level prediction can be effective for NMT, and also introduce two novel sequence-level versions of knowledge distillation that further improve performance, and somewhat surprisingly, seem to eliminate the need for beam search (even when applied on the original teacher model).

semi supervised learning for neural mach.subject: semi-supervised approach for training NMT models
semi supervised learning for neural mach.claim: The paper proposes a semi-supervised approach for training NMT models on the concatenation of labeled (parallel corpora) and unlabeled (monolingual corpora) data.
semi supervised learning for neural mach.quote: We propose a semi-supervised approach for training NMT models on the concatenation of labeled (parallel corpora) and unlabeled (monolingual corpora) data.

semi supervised learning for neural mach.subject: autoencoder
semi supervised learning for neural mach.claim: The central idea is to reconstruct the monolingual corpora using an autoencoder, in which the source-to-target and target-to-source translation models serve as the encoder and decoder, respectively.
semi supervised learning for neural mach.quote: The central idea is to reconstruct the monolingual corpora using an autoencoder, in which the source-to-target and target-to-source translation models serve as the encoder and decoder, respectively.

semi supervised learning for neural mach.subject: semi-supervised approach for training NMT models
semi supervised learning for neural mach.claim: Experiments on the Chinese-English dataset show that the approach achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art SMT and NMT systems.
semi supervised learning for neural mach.quote: Experiments on the Chinese-English dataset show that our approach achieves significant improvements over state-of-the-art SMT and NMT systems.

semi supervised learning for neural mach.subject: NMT systems
semi supervised learning for neural mach.claim: NMT systems only rely on parallel corpora for parameter estimation, which are usually limited in quantity, quality, and coverage, especially for low-resource languages.
semi supervised learning for neural mach.quote: While end-to-end neural machine translation (NMT) has made remarkable progress recently, NMT systems only rely on parallel corpora for parameter estimation. Since parallel corpora are usually limited in quantity, quality, and coverage, especially for low-resource languages, it is appealing to exploit monolingual corpora to improve NMT.

linguistic input features improve neural.subject: generalized embedding layer
linguistic input features improve neural.claim: The paper generalizes the embedding layer of the encoder in the attentional encoder--decoder architecture to support the inclusion of arbitrary features, in addition to the baseline word feature.
linguistic input features improve neural.quote: We generalize the embedding layer of the encoder in the attentional encoder--decoder architecture to support the inclusion of arbitrary features, in addition to the baseline word feature.

linguistic input features improve neural.subject: neural machine translation systems
linguistic input features improve neural.claim: Morphological features, part-of-speech tags, and syntactic dependency labels are added as input features to English German, and English->Romanian neural machine translation systems.
linguistic input features improve neural.quote: We add morphological features, part-of-speech tags, and syntactic dependency labels as input features to English German, and English->Romanian neural machine translation systems.

linguistic input features improve neural.subject: linguistic input features
linguistic input features improve neural.claim: Linguistic input features improve model quality according to three metrics: perplexity, BLEU and CHRF3.
linguistic input features improve neural.quote: In experiments on WMT16 training and test sets, we find that linguistic input features improve model quality according to three metrics: perplexity, BLEU and CHRF3.

linguistic input features improve neural.subject: neural MT models
linguistic input features improve neural.claim: The strong learning capability of neural MT models does not make linguistic features redundant; they can be easily incorporated to provide further improvements in performance.
linguistic input features improve neural.quote: In this paper we show that the strong learning capability of neural MT models does not make linguistic features redundant; they can be easily incorporated to provide further improvements in performance.

edinburgh neural machine translation sys.subject: Edinburgh Neural Machine Translation Systems
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.claim: The systems are based on an attentional encoder-decoder using BPE subword segmentation for open-vocabulary translation with a fixed vocabulary.
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.quote: Our systems are based on an attentional encoder-decoder, using BPE subword segmentation for open-vocabulary translation with a fixed vocabulary.

edinburgh neural machine translation sys.subject: Automatic back-translations
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.claim: The authors experimented with using automatic back-translations of the monolingual News corpus as additional training data.
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.quote: We experimented with using automatic back-translations of the monolingual News corpus as additional training data, pervasive dropout, and target-bidirectional models.

edinburgh neural machine translation sys.subject: Pervasive dropout
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.claim: The authors experimented with pervasive dropout as part of their system configuration.
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.quote: We experimented with using automatic back-translations of the monolingual News corpus as additional training data, pervasive dropout, and target-bidirectional models.

edinburgh neural machine translation sys.subject: Target-bidirectional models
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.claim: The authors experimented with target-bidirectional models.
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.quote: We experimented with using automatic back-translations of the monolingual News corpus as additional training data, pervasive dropout, and target-bidirectional models.

edinburgh neural machine translation sys.subject: Edinburgh Neural Machine Translation Systems
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.claim: All reported methods give substantial improvements, resulting in improvements of 4.3--11.2 BLEU over the baseline systems.
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.quote: All reported methods give substantial improvements, and we see improvements of 4.3--11.2 BLEU over our baseline systems.

edinburgh neural machine translation sys.subject: Edinburgh Neural Machine Translation Systems
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.claim: In the human evaluation, the systems were the (tied) best constrained system for 7 out of 8 translation directions in which they participated.
edinburgh neural machine translation sys.quote: In the human evaluation, our systems were the (tied) best constrained system for 7 out of 8 translation directions in which we participated.

agreement on target bidirectional neural.subject: Neural machine translation (NMT) with recurrent neural networks
agreement on target bidirectional neural.claim: NMT with recurrent neural networks typically suffers from an issue of unbalanced outputs arising from the nature of RNNs and inherent MT challenges.
agreement on target bidirectional neural.quote: However, in spite of its promising advances over traditional translation meth-ods, it typically suffers from an issue of unbalanced outputs, that arise from both the nature of recurrent neural networks themselves, and the challenges inherent in machine translation.

agreement on target bidirectional neural.subject: agreement model for neural machine translation
agreement on target bidirectional neural.claim: The authors propose an agreement model for neural machine translation to overcome the issue of unbalanced outputs.
agreement on target bidirectional neural.quote: To overcome this issue, we propose an agreement model for neural machine translation and show its effectiveness on large-scale Japanese-to-English and Chinese-to-English translation tasks.

agreement on target bidirectional neural.subject: agreement model for neural machine translation
agreement on target bidirectional neural.claim: The proposed model achieves improvements of up to 1.4 B LEU over the strongest baseline NMT system.
agreement on target bidirectional neural.quote: Our results show the model can achieve improvements of up to 1.4 B LEU over the strongest baseline NMT system.

agreement on target bidirectional neural.subject: agreement model for neural machine translation
agreement on target bidirectional neural.claim: With the help of an ensemble technique, the new end-to-end NMT approach outperformed phrase-based and hierarchical phrase-based Moses baselines by up to 5.6 B LEU points.
agreement on target bidirectional neural.quote: With the help of an ensemble technique, this new end-to-end NMT approach ﬁnally outperformed phrase-based and hierarchical phrase-based Moses baselines by up to 5.6 B LEU points.

theano a python framework for fast compu.subject: Theano
theano a python framework for fast compu.claim: Theano is a Python library that allows to define, optimize, and evaluate mathematical expressions involving multi-dimensional arrays efficiently.
theano a python framework for fast compu.quote: Theano is a Python library that allows to define, optimize, and evaluate mathematical expressions involving multi-dimensional arrays efficiently.

theano a python framework for fast compu.subject: Theano
theano a python framework for fast compu.claim: Theano has been one of the most used CPU and GPU mathematical compilers, especially in the machine learning community, and has shown steady performance improvements.
theano a python framework for fast compu.quote: Since its introduction, it has been one of the most used CPU and GPU mathematical compilers - especially in the machine learning community - and has shown steady performance improvements.

theano a python framework for fast compu.subject: Theano
theano a python framework for fast compu.claim: Theano has been used to produce many state-of-the-art machine learning models.
theano a python framework for fast compu.quote: Theano is being actively and continuously developed since 2008, multiple frameworks have been built on top of it and it has been used to produce many state-of-the-art machine learning models.

theano a python framework for fast compu.subject: Theano
theano a python framework for fast compu.claim: The performance of Theano is compared against Torch7 and TensorFlow on several machine learning models.
theano a python framework for fast compu.quote: Section IV compares the performance of Theano against Torch7 and TensorFlow on several machine learning models.

theano a python framework for fast compu.subject: Theano

theano a python framework for fast compu.quote: Section V discusses current limitations of Theano and potential ways of improving it.

transfer learning for low resource neura.subject: transfer learning method
transfer learning for low resource neura.claim: The method involves training a high-resource language pair (parent model) and transferring learned parameters to a low-resource pair (child model) to initialize and constrain training.
transfer learning for low resource neura.quote: Our key idea is to first train a high-resource language pair (the parent model), then transfer some of the learned parameters to the low-resource pair (the child model) to initialize and constrain training.

transfer learning for low resource neura.subject: transfer learning method
transfer learning for low resource neura.claim: The transfer learning method improves baseline NMT models by an average of 5.6 Bleu on four low-resource language pairs.
transfer learning for low resource neura.quote: Using our transfer learning method we improve baseline NMT models by an average of 5.6 Bleu on four low-resource language pairs.

transfer learning for low resource neura.subject: transfer learning method
transfer learning for low resource neura.claim: Ensembling and unknown word replacement add another 2 Bleu, bringing NMT performance on low-resource machine translation close to a strong syntax based machine translation system.
transfer learning for low resource neura.quote: Ensembling and unknown word replacement add another 2 Bleu which brings the NMT performance on low-resource machine translation close to a strong syntax based machine translation (SBMT) system, exceeding its performance on one language pair.

transfer learning for low resource neura.subject: transfer learning model

transfer learning for low resource neura.quote: Additionally, using the transfer learning model for re-scoring, we can improve the SBMT system by an average of 1.3 Bleu, improving the state-of-the-art on low-resource machine translation.

transfer learning for low resource neura.subject: encoder-decoder framework
transfer learning for low resource neura.claim: The encoder-decoder framework for neural machine translation is much less effective for low-resource languages compared to large data scenarios.
transfer learning for low resource neura.quote: The encoder-decoder framework for neural machine translation (NMT) has been shown effective in large data scenarios, but is much less effective for low-resource languages.

achieving open vocabulary neural machine.subject: hybrid word-character NMT system
achieving open vocabulary neural machine.claim: The paper presents a novel word-character solution that builds hybrid systems translating mostly at the word level and consulting character components for rare words.
achieving open vocabulary neural machine.quote: This paper presents a novel word-character solution to achieving open vocabulary NMT. We build hybrid systems that translate mostly at the word level and consult the character components for rare words.

achieving open vocabulary neural machine.subject: hybrid word-character NMT system
achieving open vocabulary neural machine.claim: The hybrid approach is much faster and easier to train than character-based ones and never produces unknown words as in the case of word-based models.
achieving open vocabulary neural machine.quote: The twofold advantage of such a hybrid approach is that it is much faster and easier to train than character-based ones; at the same time, it never produces unknown words as in the case of word-based models.

neural machine translation by jointly le.quote: In this paper, we conjecture that the use of a fixed-length vector is a bottleneck in improving the performance of this basic encoder-decoder architecture, and propose to extend this by allowing a model to automatically (soft-)search for parts of a source sentence that are relevant to predicting a target word, without having to form these parts as a hard segment explicitly.

neural machine translation by jointly le.subject: neural machine translation with soft alignment
neural machine translation by jointly le.claim: The new approach achieves a translation performance comparable to the existing state-of-the-art phrase-based system on the task of English-to-French translation.
neural machine translation by jointly le.quote: With this new approach, we achieve a translation performance comparable to the existing state-of-the-art phrase-based system on the task of English-to-French translation.

recurrent continuous translation models.subject: Recurrent Continuous Translation Models
recurrent continuous translation models.claim: Recurrent Continuous Translation Models are probabilistic continuous translation models that rely purely on continuous representations for words, phrases, and sentences without using alignments or phrasal translation units.
recurrent continuous translation models.quote: We introduce a class of probabilistic continuous translation models called Recurrent Continuous Translation Models that are purely based on continuous representations for words, phrases and sentences and do not rely on alignments or phrasal translation units.

recurrent continuous translation models.subject: Recurrent Continuous Translation Models
recurrent continuous translation models.claim: The generation of the translation is modelled with a target Recurrent Language Model, while the conditioning on the source sentence is modelled with a Convolutional Sentence Model.
recurrent continuous translation models.quote: The generation of the translation is modelled with a target Recurrent Language Model, whereas the conditioning on the source sentence is modelled with a Convolutional Sentence Model.

recurrent continuous translation models.subject: Recurrent Continuous Translation Models
recurrent continuous translation models.claim: The models obtain a perplexity with respect to gold translations that is more than 43% lower than that of state-of-the-art alignment-based translation models.
recurrent continuous translation models.quote: Through various experiments, we show first that our models obtain a perplexity with respect to gold translations that is > 43% lower than that of stateof-the-art alignment-based translation models.

recurrent continuous translation models.subject: Recurrent Continuous Translation Models
recurrent continuous translation models.claim: The models are remarkably sensitive to the word order, syntax, and meaning of the source sentence despite lacking alignments.
recurrent continuous translation models.quote: Secondly, we show that they are remarkably sensitive to the word order, syntax, and meaning of the source sentence despite lacking alignments.

recurrent continuous translation models.subject: Recurrent Continuous Translation Models
recurrent continuous translation models.claim: The models match a state-of-the-art system when rescoring n-best lists of translations.
recurrent continuous translation models.quote: Finally we show that they match a state-of-the-art system when rescoring n-best lists of translations.

bert pre training of deep bidirectional.subject: BERT
bert pre training of deep bidirectional.claim: BERT is a new language representation model designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.
bert pre training of deep bidirectional.quote: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models (Peters et al., 2018a; Radford et al., 2018), BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers.

bert pre training of deep bidirectional.subject: BERT

bert pre training of deep bidirectional.quote: As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications.
